Master Vismer.final target: There exists one know as Lunaris Primus Pilus. On his last command he lead a force against Barfog and perished on the battlefield. Entombed in a monastery, the commander has lain peacefully for over a hundred years. With the rise of the dead, the roman commander's sleep was broken and he now haunts the crumbled monastery. You must [put to rest] Lunaris primus pilus, but must do so within the walls of the monastery. Should he fall outside its walls, he will rise once again.
Master Vismer.put to rest: Use your spell as instructed. This is no different from the last. Here are your components, hopefully they are strong enough for the deed that lay before you. Good luck! Do not hesitate to join forces with others to [accomplish] this task.

Magus Agyfen.interested: Many in our order have begun to speak at length if your missions for Sir Bors. It seems you have succeeded where many of them have failed. I would watch my back when around the likes of them. It is because of this that I hesitate to deliver this message from Captain Rhodri. I do not know that it contains, but I was informed it would be very [profitable]! May whatever god you worship watch over you. I shall only wish thee luck! Safe travels!

Captain Rhodri.assist us: This is good! I am relieved this matter will be resolved quickly in your hands. I shall not waste any more of your time than is necessary. As you are aware, the Twp ap Alsig believe it is the dwarves who have been assisting Tepok with funds and supplies. I truly doubt that dwarves would stomach working with such creatures. Yet, we cannot turn a blind eye to our newest of allies and the mine has proven a burden for too long. Therefore Sir Bors has decided that you must descend into Tepok mines, locate and slay Tepok himself. I am sure this deed should pose no problems for one of your skill. It is said Tepok carries with him a sack containing all this precious items. Return this to us as it may contain clues to location these dwarves. Best of luck to thee.
Captain Rhodri.Twr ap Alsig: Were you able to deliver the dispatch to Twr ap Alsig?
Captain Rhodri.scouts were spotted: Aye! We are unsure if there are other such passages but if there are, we shall find them. We still need to search Pennine and locate the source of these supplies! Unfortunately we cannot afford to use any of our own scouts. I have been asked to task you with this delicate mission. We can no longer limit our source of information to observation alone. Someone must [venture into the camps] of each race within the Pennine and return solid reports.
Captain Rhodri.venture into the camps: Not to worry Cabalist! We will not send you into these camps blindly. We have been observing the inhabitants of Pennine for quite some time. Are you still [willing to assist] us in this matter?
Captain Rhodri.willing to assist: Then let us begin! Your first task will be to infiltrate a camp of Tylwyth Teg elves. There is one among them named Delfina. She carries the reports of their people to and from the Tylwyth Teg homelands. Our time is short Cabalist. Do not toy with the targets! Simply locate this Delfina, slay her, and return her reports. I await your return. May your blade be swift and quite!
Captain Rhodri.matter: Sir Bors would have the support of the locals within Barfog and this situation would be the best way to win their trust. Therefore your mission is to return the to renegade post and [dispatch] the outcasts.
Captain Rhodri.dispatch: You must ensure that justice is delivered to both Dillus and his [supporting] officers. When this is complete, visit the local outpost there and talk to one named Twr ap Alsig. We have it on good authority that if you win his support the locals will follow. Take with you the Arawnite orders as proof of Sir Dillus' betrayal.

Twr ap Alsig.certain: There roams about this land the undead cythraul. Should you destroy one of these and bring back its skull as proof, I will lend the support you seek." (Also has been known to send someone to go kill a Bwgan Hunter.) [Step#3] Slay a cyhraul within Llyn Barfog! (Cythraul can be found around loc=51921, 44182 also can be found at loc=36350, 53887) [Step#4] Speak to Twr ap Alsig at the local outpost in Llyn Barfog.
Twr ap Alsig.Step#4: I still seek proof of your deeds. Do you have something for me?

Scribe Veral.local report: Yes! There is news that Bors is a target for assassination. The report does not specify who will attempt the deed, only that it will be attempted soon. I will take your case before King Constantine, but you must return with haste, and assist in thwarting this treachery!

The Spirit of the unspoken.riddle: The shadow of life passes us, as does the passage of time. When day turns to darkness, time fades into eternity. What then becomes of life?

Master Gerol.Book of Arawn: Seek out this Saelonna within the borders of Snowdonia and retrieve this book at whatever the cost. Return to me when you have completed this task. May your travel be swift and uneventful!
Master Gerol.<Player>: There have been sightings of this beast in the southern portions of the Pennine Mountains. You would be wise to start your search there. Should you encounter this <Player>, slay it and return its remains to Caelin Finan of Castle Sauvage. I believe with the right combination of spells he may be able to delve the location of this tower. Now be on your way! Time is short!

Captain Herly.test your limits and skills: Our superiors have sent word that a former member of the Defenders of Albion, Gavon Montgomery, is once again working with us. They did not tell more than he is working with the Defenders and that his task is very important. He has requested assistance with his work, and our superiors felt it was time for you to use some of the skills you have been gifted with. Apparently Gavon needs to recover something that has been lost, and our superiors all agree that you are ready to help him. Do [you agree with them]?
Captain Herly.you agree with them: I believe you are correct. Go to Gavon Montgomery now and he will tell you more of his [assignment] with the Defenders. You shall find him at Caifelle on the road north of Gothwaite Harbor. I shall pray for your safety while you are out in this dangerous world.

Lieutenant Newster.first line: Certainly. It is not only here in the Isle of Glass that your skills as a Scout will be sought after. Back in Albion, in the frontier lands, our enemies seek to overtake the realm. It is something you should [consider].
Lieutenant Newster.consider: Yes, but don't make any hasty decisions. You should speak to Elaru, with the Guild of Shadows, to learn of life as an Infiltrator.

Gavon Montgomery.tracking down lost objects: As you may know, the Defenders of Albion are always searching for better ways to defend the realm from enemies. Our duty is hard, for these days we face not onlythe enemies that nip at our borders but also the ones that exist amongst us. Anything that can be done or used to make our fight a little easier is always well supported among the Defenders. That is [why I was sent] here.
Gavon Montgomery.why I was sent: One of the Inconnu that has been helping us to defend the realm against the Drakoran located and recovered a stone that seems to weaken the Drakoran. Our Theurgists back in Camelot wish to examine and study this stone so that it can possibly be duplicated and used to aid us in this fight. If we [only had it now]!
Gavon Montgomery.only had it now: This Inconnu was coming back from getting the stone when he was attacked and overpowered by a pack of urchin rabblerousers. They stole the stone and ran off into the wilds when the Inconnu mandaged to crawl back here. So far no one has been able to capture the little rabblerouser that has it. Go now and seek out the urchin rabblerouser that has it. They are tricky and throw it around, so keep trying until you find it. We are counting on you.

Master Grundelth.something to do: I require the use of your brain more than the use of your brawn today. A few days ago, an ancient book was uncovered near [Stonehenge]. Whoever wrote this book must have been wise.
Master Grundelth.Three sages: Each of them is also a master of three different, [ancient languages]. I know enough to figure out what the language is, but understanding it is a different matter.
Master Grundelth.ancient languages: You must first find the tower in Camelot Hills that Sage Nelson has been assigned to. She has studied the Lemnian tongue, spoken on the island of Lemnos. She will tell you the location of the [other two].
Master Grundelth.other two: The other two sages are at different towers. Just take the book to them and let them have a look at it. I still know not what puzzled them about the [weather] there.
Master Grundelth.weather: The academy has decided to watch the weather in hopes of someday, being able to see into the future and know if it will rain in a few days. What a daft notion. [About that book]...

Mistress Trethia.adventurers: Aye! Your services are needed now! If you are [interested] and adventure is what you seek.

Magus Oreal.adventurers: Aye! Your services are needed now! If you are [interested] and adventure is what you seek.

Master Lorik.adventurers: Aye! Your services are needed now! If you are [interested] and adventure is what you seek.

Olorustos.a message: Yes! There is a guardian by the name of Aron. He stands on eternal watch against those who would wish to steal our treasured artifacts. It is to him you must deliver this message. He stands along the riverbanks just west of the road. Hurry to him!
Olorustos.can help: Yes, there is an outcast member of our association known as Ormgarth who has been [causing problems].

Mistress Laws.suspicion: They have seen the Drakoran ruin their lands, they have witnessed Morgana's terrible magic first hand, so they cannot be expected to trust these new, powerful allies. I expect you to treat the Inconnu as allies, and to try and avoid the idle gossip of the local townsfolk. Saying that, I must send you to one of the loudest of the rabble. Ylaine Barrett. The food cellar has been swarming with swamp goo, and she wants someone to go out and clear the [immediate] area of swamp goo. Don't worry, I don't expect you to kill them all, just do what you can.

Ylaine Barrett.before: Yes, well, before, well, before they came. Don't you remember? That night? All day long, everything's fine. Set itself uop for a fine next day, as well! The night, it was clear. Not a sign of a storm in sight! Why, no one prepared for it! Then, in the darkest part, suddenly, the storm starts! We were woken from the noise of it! It was awful, but we didn't dare go outside! Some of the men, they did, but they came back pale as a corpse! Were shaken to their core! And some of these being the fightin' men! Best of the town! Aye, but the [swamp goo].
Ylaine Barrett.swamp goo: They've gotten into the food cellar! The slimy things were creeping all over that place! I've gotten rid of most of the swamp goo, but I know there's more just outside town working their way to my food stores. I think you could do a small favor for us all and get rid of some. Oh and while you are at it, the skin of the swamp goo, I've some uses for it. I'll pay you for a swamp goo skin. Just go and get me one of their skins, and I'll be satisfied with ya.

Narah.defeat Morgana: Morgana has raised many of Arawn's souls, and she has also summoned to her side the Drakoran armies! These Drakoran are as much an enemy to Arawn as Morgana, for those that serve Morgana work against Arawn. The Drakoran invaded Avalon, and all that is here, in the Isle of Glass, that is all that is left of the people of Avalon. The others are dead. The cannot [fight the battle] alone.
Narah.fight the battle: But while they can no longer fight the battle against the Drakoran without our aid, many still mistrust us. Trynt Madoc has decided the best way to earn the trust and loyalty of the people of the Isle of Glass is to prove our value and dedication to the battle against Morgana. It is not required of you, but helping Trynt may be an [opportunutiy] to practice your skills.
Narah.speaking out: Yes, she believes it would be better to die at the hands of Morgana and her Drakoran minions than to consort with those of the realm of the dead. I do not believe many in the town share the same [sentiment], but it would be nice to not hear her cackling tongue for a change.
Narah.falling to the Drakoran: Well, that is the [alternative] to accepting our aid, since they obviously can't defeat Morgana without our help. Trynt recognizes this, and would like your help again.
Narah.speak: It is time for you to move forward in your training. Talk to Carys, the necromancer trainer. You have learned all you can from me.

Trynt Madoc.prove differently: I told Burton that the Inconnu brought a poison with them that is very effective against Drakoran. He said he would believe that there Inconnu are here to help if he could get a sample of the poison and the list of components to make it himself. Lirele, an Inconnu who is working with us, has agreed to help but she needs [a certain component] to finish the poison.
Trynt Madoc.a certain component: Lirele told me she needed the fin (of) a sea pup to complete the poison. They live in the waters around Gothwaite Harbor. Get one and take it to Lirele. [Step #2] Get the fin of a sea pup from the waters outside Gothwaite Harbor. Sea pups are located just to the end of town near the water's edge. Get a fin and take it to Lirele.
Trynt Madoc.servants of Morgana: Yes, I cannot believe it either, for I have seen the Inconnu out on the field of battle, sacrificing themselves in the fight against the Drakoran and Morgana's undead. They won't stop fighting until the last breath has passed through their lips. Yet still people do not believe they are here to help but will [be our downfall].
Trynt Madoc.be our downfall: Now, not everyone believes this, but there is a core group that does. The group's second in command is a woman named Tessa Ohrman. She is always saying the Inconnu are here to stir up the undead, not gather up the souls ripped from their peaceful slumber by Morgana. We need you to prove to Tessa that she is wrong about the Inconnu. If we win Tessa to our side, she will convince the leader, Calder to change his mind. Go to Tessa now, and speak with her. I told her you would be coming to speak with her.

Barnarn the crier.task: Seek out a fellow member of this realm. Fashion between you a group and return to me. I will instruct you further then.

Stonemason Harwin.weapon: Aye, though you may scoff at the idea, stone weapons, if made correctly can be quite effective. I can make a [knife], a [club], or a [dirk] depending on the shape of the [chert] I start with.
Stonemason Harwin.chert: Ok, I should be able to manage a dirk for you. I'll need a thin [chert] though to get the best thrusting action. If you bring me one I'll make you a dirk.

Sister Genette Ashlan.the storm hit: Aye, the storm that brought the likes of you to these shores. It has been a beautiful day that day. The evening started out beautiful too, clear and calm. A group of soldiers had left as the sun was just dipping below the horizon to go on patrol. With not a cloud in the sky, the group didn't take torches but relied upon the light of the stars to guide them. Out in the middle of nowhere, a group of those nasty Drakorans ambushed a group of soldiers. There was a violent fight with many dead on both sides. A few of the soldiers survived and managed to crawl back towards Caer Gothwaite. When they were spotted, the watchers [sent for me].
Sister Genette Ashlan.sent for me: I gathered my things and hurried outside to meet those poor men and women. They were seriously hurt, but I thought I could save them. I began to treat using a magical healing potion given to me but another healer. It cleans the wound and makes it heal much faster and also counteracts the evil poison of the Drakorans. As I moved along treating each wound, a breeze began to blow gently. It took a few hours for me to treat each of them. As I reached the last one, the wind began to blow harder. One of my assistants suddenly gasped as dark clouds rolled in, blocking out the light of the stars. As the rain began to fall, [we gathered up] the wounded and hurried into the shelter of the Caer. Before we had even crossed the courtyard the lightning was blinding and the thunder deafening, and we wondered if we would be drown by the rain.
Sister Genette Ashlan.we gathered up: In the chaos of the storm and protecting the soldiers, I dropped my healing potion. No one was brave enough to go back out and look for it. I tried to search for it, but the storm was too violent and I could not even make it out the door. I did my best to treat the last soldier, but [without the potion] I could not cure him of the poison and he died. All because of the likes of you! You caused the storm and make that soldier die! That is why I don't like your kind!
Sister Genette Ashlan.without the potion: Trynt said that Inconnu witch Lirele would replace my potion if I told her. The potion requires two bones from damp skeletons. Get them and take them to Lirele if you want to prove the Inconnu are not the evil creatures I believe they are!
Sister Genette Ashlan.strange priest: Aye, I'll not understand the workings of your folk, <Player>, truly I shan't. But he is a strange fellow. Came to me at the oddest times to tell me your folk were getting sick, and needed tending, and about threatened me with Arawn's wrath when I said then Arawn should have thought of tending the Inconnu's illness' himslef before he threw that temple in the middle of our town. Aye, but I'm a healer, and heal I will, but you're a strange folk, and need a different sort of tending. I've got everything I need, but one thing. I need one more [ingredient] to this concoction I'm cooking up.
Sister Genette Ashlan.ingredient: Off the coast, near the water, you can usually see the sea pups out there. The skin of the sea pup has an oily feel to it. I need to scrape off the oils from the skin and boil it. Aye, it's my problem how, I'll manage that. You just go get me the skin.

Master Reginald.troubles: Aye, the never go away. I'd like you to lend a hand. I'll [understand] if you don't, but I thikn you could benefit a little from it.
Master Reginald.threatened: Aye. It seems he's instigated the whole swamp goo cellar [infestation] and began the sickness with the Inconnu. As long as the Inconnu are here, he will be a threat. I think we should aid Tage.

Tage.collect: Bring me a swamp goo. Dead, preferably. The roam just outside of town.

Crep Pew.Imps: They want us out so the can loot the [town].
Crep Pew.town: They are pushing boulders down the hill that are damaging our buildings and injuring [people].
Crep Pew.people: My [shop] has been damaged and my [daughter] injured.
Crep Pew.daughter: Please help us by killing the imps and their leader.
Crep Pew.assistance: Will you brave warriors please [assist] us?
Crep Pew.assist: If you bring me the evidence that you have killed them, you will be handsomely rewarded.

Tessa Ohrman.causing trouble: The undead have been attacking people, especially the headless dead. They are the remains of people who have had terrible accidents upon the shores of this land. They never bothered us until the Inconnu came! Everyone said it was Morgana's doing, but I know the truth! If you think you can prove that the Inconnu are not here to cause trouble, [retrieve the souls] of three headless dead.
Tessa Ohrman.retrieve the souls: When you have them, take them to that Inconnu Lirele over there. She claims she can send them away, but I don't believe her. You get them, take them to her, and I'll watch to see if she does it or if she turns them loosee on us here in Caer Gothwaite! Now go!
Tessa Ohrman.can admit: It's not easy, and I don't trust the Inconnu, but I will stop saying that they are here to cause trouble, and I will work on changing Calder's mind too. I don't know if he will listen, but I will try. To show I am not such a bad person as some think, please [sic]take this.

Elaru.Stealth: Yes, and twilight your sawn, for the work of an infiltrator is best accomplished when the sky is darkened and the land asleep. You will be sent to the enemy's arms. and expected to return successfully. [Death] is the only excuse for failing.
Elaru.Death: Consider your choices when the time comes. Think well what Arawn would wish for you.

Master Torr.pursue: Then let us begin our lesson! There are but four guild in Albion. They are the [Church of Albion], the [Defender of Albion], the [Guild of Shadows], and the [Academy].
Master Torr.Academy: Our glorious church stands eternal in the light of Camelot! Their faith strives to bring order to chaos, faith to the faithless, light where there is darkness!
Master Torr.Paladin: You wish to be a defender of the faith I take it? Many a Paladin has led our fighters into battle with victory not far behind. Their never-ending sacrifices proves that the Church of Albion will remain for many centuries! To give your life of service to the Church of Albion, seek out Lord Prydwen of Lady Triss within the city of Camelot!
Master Torr.Armsman: The Academy is Albion's tome of knowledge! From withing it's walls ushers forth untold power!

Gronyr Gloyw.zombie swine: Aye, foul and corrupted undead swine rise from the ground at [night] and dance around their unholy master, a zombie farmer. If you bring me rotting hig tails as proof that you have killed them, I will reward you.
Gronyr Gloyw.night: Only at night do the beasts rise from the grave to ravage my fields. Even if you do not agree to help me, beware [walking] the road near m farm at night, for evil walks the land.

Hugh Gallen.bit of information: Listen close! Lord Prydwen once had a faithful cleric, known as Mulgrut. His service to our realm was unparallel. Yet, during Arthur's siege on Lancelot, his son, <Player>, [was slain].
Hugh Gallen.was slain: Yes! Mulgrut [never recovered] from that. He turned his eyes from God and never looked back.
Hugh Gallen.never recovered: Aye! Even in death his soul never rests. If you are interested, I can tell you how to [make a profit] from this!

Lieutenant Jursen.throatripper: Yeah, an [angry wolf] who has taken up living in these woods.
Lieutenant Jursen.angry wolf: I would have taked care of it myself, but I cannot leave my post. Will you [kill it]? I will reward you!
Lieutenant Jursen.Marie: She is a Seamstress in Ludlow.

Seamstress Marie.services: Well I can do most any leatherwork you may require. Do you have a [pelt] that you wish me to examine?
Seamstress Marie.pelt: I assume you required my leatherworking skills do you not? Let me see it!

Commander Burcrif.displeased: I know now what might truly displease a snake, but I do know where he may be found. Are you [interested]?

Cullen Smyth.cargo: My cargo of fine apple brandy that I was [delivering] to the King's table. Did you know that Hakon is a master wood craftsman as well as a hunter?

Kaere.gifted with the knowledge: Lord Arawn deemed me worthy to be skilled in potion making. Together with Enchanter Slone, we have developed a potion that will shield and protect the town for a while. There isn't a potion that will grant the town permanent protection - it is only through the destruction of the Drakoran that the town will be safe again. Until then I shall do everything in my power [to aid Lady Treva] in protecting her town.
Kaere.to aid Lady Treva: Lady Trevahas asked me to make this potion, as well as perform my daily tasks for her. I do not have the time to gather the necessary components for this potion and Enchanter Slone must remain here to serve those seeking enchantments. If I was to tell you what we needed, could you [get it for me]? [Will you gather the components for Keare's spell to protect Anniogel?]
Kaere.Will you gather the components for Keare: Enchanter Slone has called upon his knowledge of the magic of this land and combined it with my knowledge of the dead. Together the two make a powerful protection potion. All the components for the potion [can be found] on creatures that roam this land.
Kaere.can be found: For Enchanter Slone's part of the potion we will need a draft of water from a lesser water elemental. It shall be the base of the potion. I shall give you a container to capture the water in when we are finished speaking. You will also need to get the tail of a giant dragon fly and then some dirt from an urchin rabblerouser. Both items will aid in forming the invisible wall to repel the Drakoran from this town. There is one more thing you will need for the potion. and that is [my ingredient].
Kaere.my ingredient: I require the glowing spirit ston of the ghosts that roam the land. By placing the spirit stone of one of Morgana's servants into the potion it shall aid to break the power she has over this land. You may aquire these four components in any order you wish, but you must bring me all four to brew the potion. Do you [need directions] to the creatures you must hunt or do you [know already] where they are?
Kaere.know already: I am pleased that you are so familiar with the creatures of this land. Here is the vial to capture the water from the lesser water elemental. If you should forget the locations of any of the creatures, come back and speak with me. Remember, you may obtain the [components] in any order. If you lose this vial, return to me and I shall give you another one, but do your best not to lose it! Good luck, <Player>.
Kaere.using an item: To use and item, drag the icon of the potion ove to your quickbar. Then type the letter of the Use item key (check your keyboard mapping to see what it is set as), then type or click the number of the hotkey where you will put the potion. This will allow you to use the item. Good luck, <Player>!
Kaere.a gift: Some of the finest craftspeople in the land worked hard to create this, <Player>, and now we present it to you. We cannot thank you enough for your service to Anniogel, <Player>. Lord Arawan and Lady Lile shall look upon you with favor for your help. Fare thee well, <Player>.

Vadri Pade.the tale: You do not know of the [druid tale]?
Vadri Pade.druid tale: Ah well I suppose to could be persuaded to speak it one last time. Have a seat and let us begin.
Vadri Pade.Druids: Yes! These priests are the very same that walk our lands once again. During the time of Arillius and Uther the push to rid our land of the Celts almost succeeded. Yet tolerance became the motive of Uther during his later years and was adopted by ARthur as well. This tolerance has unfortunately led to our current [predicament].
Vadri Pade.predicament: Have you not seen the druids that are encroaching into our area? One need not walk more than half-day to encounter them. These are our lands regardless of their attachment to the [standing stones]!
Vadri Pade.standing stones: The druids have long practiced their pagan arts in and about these stones. I know not where the stones originated, but the druid fascination over them increases with each generation. I can only assume they believe the stones to contain some holy power. It must be this false belief that ties them to our lands. You seem [quite enthralled] by these druids. If you wish I could direct you to someone who would speak in more depth of this subject?

Master Kless.new and old: Yes! While both still practice the basic paths taught them generations ago, it is the newest of druids that seek to reclaim that which they lost so long ago. Their hold on Salisbury and parts of the Campacorentin Forest are proof of this. Some have actually pressed into the Black Mountains seeking to claim land closer and closer to Camelot. There are many within our realm that now fight to ensure this spread will not continue. I know three thta keeps tabs upon the very movement of these druids and research their history in depth. Though I fear this will do [little to assist] us now, I am certain it will allow us to take greater action in the future.
Master Kless.little to assist: Already we are having difficulty in stopping the druids to our north. They gain greater courage the closer they come to Camelot. Unlike the [druids of old] that held land for a generation or so before moving on, these fruids move with blazing speed. Their thirst to reclaim all that was taken from them seems never to be filled.
Master Kless.druids of old: From what I've learned, once their priest had taken Keltoi as their primary place of learning the druidic spread all but stopped. They turned their attention to developing a culture within our lands and building places of worship. Now it seems these druids press into our realm as if on act of vengeance. Their only goal is to secure all land that was once their own regardless of the [bloodshed].
Master Kless.bloodshed: You should witness this for yourself. To be told the deeds of these people is nothing compared to actually experiencing their wrath first hand. If you would be willing to travel into the black mountains and [slay a sacrificer] I will reward you.
Master Kless.slay a sacrificer: That's correct! Bring me the sacrificer's dagger as well. I believe the hill they occupy is just north of the double bridge. Best of luck to thee.

Brother Lensar.well this day: I am glad to hear that. I myself am well too, but not everyone in this world is. I am thinking of one soul in particular. His name is [Bishop Burhoff].
Brother Lensar.Bishop Burhoff: Bishop Burhoff was the most trusted advisor of Lord Aryon. Lord Aryon ruled a castle in Avalon Marsh. During Mordred's Rebellion, the castle was attacked, and Lord Aryon rallied his men to defeat Morgana's armies. Lord Aryon and his men were just about to win when they were betreyed by Bishop Burhoff. He had kept his loyalty to Morgana a secret. He arranged for Lord Aryon to be stabbed and poisoned, then he opened the gates to Morgana's evil creatures. As Lord Aryon lay dying, his men being massacred, he cursed Bishop Burhoff for his treachery. A knight heard the curse, and sacrificed himself to make sure Bishop Burhoff died and [the curse was fulfilled].
Brother Lensar.the curse was fulfilled: The curse insured that Bishop Burhoff would haunt the Vetusta Abeey in the night. But we of the Church believe that Bishop Burhoff has come to feel regret for his actions and we wish to know more. All we are lacking at this point is a brave soul to assist us. Do you happen to [know of one].
Brother Lensar.determine Burhoff's will: Lately we have seen Burhoff's spirit roaming the halls of this Church late at night. We believe that he wants to talk to us, but cannot yet. I believe he needs something from his former life to [link him to this world].
Brother Lensar.link him to this world: I believe his remains will work as the link. You will have to defeat him to get access to his remains, for he guards them closely. If you could get his skull, that will be enough. Venture to Vetusta Abbey now, and return when you have it!

Bishop Burhoff.a church: If I am in a church, then perhaps the time has come to lift the curse that is upon me. If I only I could rid myself of this curse. I could seek out Lord Aryon in the otherworld and [beg his forgiveness]. But as long as I am cursed, I cannot seek him out to beg his forgiveness.
Bishop Burhoff.beg his forgiveness: Aye, I would beg his forgiveness. I was entranced by Morgana's beauty and spells, and didn't see the error of my ways until I lay dying. I only wish now to make it right. But I need help to [break the curse].
Bishop Burhoff.break the curse: To break the curse, I need a adder fang. I will use it to slice my [ties to this earth], breaking the curse. When I was alive, you could find them in Forest Sauvage. I'd start there.
Bishop Burhoff.ties to this earth: Once you have it, return to me here. Take this skull with you, so that you may speak to me again when you return. The blessing of the Church upon you, my child.

Achae Smith.out here: Oh, I know he meant well, thinking we could have a better life and all, that it would be less crowded than Camelot, which mind you, it is, but still...
Achae Smith.Cabalist Meical: I don't know the whole story, but I can share with you what I know. Not so long ago, a great cabalist by the name of Meical came here to Devwy. No one knows his reasons for coming, but some say it was to [shun] society.
Achae Smith.shun: In order to survive here, he built automated constructs of varying types and sizes. The more he was away from civilization, the more mad he went. Eventually, he lost his mind completely. That is when his creations [turned] on him.
Achae Smith.turned: Oh yes. They killed him and then left their prison to roam around the hills and valleys of Devwy. They will harm anyone in their path. That is why I am [concerned] for my uncle's safety.
Achae Smith.concerned: My uncle left a few days ago to make a trip to Wearyall Hill to trade for some supplies we desperately needed. The caravan has not returned yet, and our guards found some pieces of [shredded clothing] in the woods a days travel from here.
Achae Smith.shredded clothing: I went out exploring fir a little bit yesterday where the guards had found the shredded bits and discovered [this] as well.
Achae Smith.this: It's a chunk of metal from what I believe is a [forged servant].
Achae Smith.forged servant: A forged servant is a very aggressive construct of Meical's, forged from the very same metal used to make anvils. If a forged servant did take my uncle, there's no telling what they might have [done] to him!
Achae Smith.done: Please froend, will you help me out and [search] for my uncle?
Achae Smith.remains: We can give him a proper burial through the Church of Albion if we had his remains. Oh, but I do so hope for the best. Gracien Adamson is our local scholar around here. You should speak with him about Meical's creatures.
Achae Smith.another favor: Will you please find <Player>'s remains for me? I would like to have a proper burial for him. It would mean so much to me if you [would fo this] for me.
Achae Smith.would fo this: Oh thank you friend. I am indebted to you. Please return to me when you find the remains.

Gracien Adamson.Achae Smith: Yes... I heard about her uncle's strange disappearance. And then her finding of that metal. It's hardly what I'd call evidence, as you can find pieces of forged servants just about everywhere. Still, if she wants me to talk with you, I see [no harm].
Gracien Adamson.no harm: The forged servants are constructs made out of a dense steel, the same you'd find in an anvil. You'll sometimes hear them referred to as [anvil monsters], but I don't know how common that name is.
Gracien Adamson.anvil monsters: I'm sure you know that they were made by Meical in order to serve him. Make no mistake, friend. These creatures are pure evil, a menace to us and any who come upon them. I'll tell you [what], though.
Gracien Adamson.what: I know and alchemist who could determine if a forged servant really did make off with Achae's uncle. All you need is to get that piece of metal her and then come back to me. Don't worry, I'm sure she'll give it to you.

Elyn Badam.list: First, I need a piece of bark from Brother Josef's tree. It's the large one on the hill over yonder, you can't miss it. Secondly, I need a Golden Orb from a Drakoran Mage. Lastly, I need a [pair of wings] from an apple fly.
Elyn Badam.pair of wings: I suggest you get the items sooner rather than later. The longer we wait, the harder it will be for me to garnish whatever information I can from this metal bit.

Lady Eilwen.increasing their power: It would not surprise me if either were the case, but who is behind it? Lurlei and I have been struggling with our spells since the arrival of the Inconnu. Oh I have heard the rumors that the Inconnu are not only here to steal our souls but our magic too. I have never heard anything more ridiculous in my life! The Inconnu are here to help us defeat with Drakoran. Why would they help us face our enemies if they only wished to destroy us? No, I believe there is [another force] at work.
Lady Eilwen.another force: Morgana, <Player>. Plain and simple. She has found some way to boost the Drakoran's magical skills. Unless we can find a way to counter their magic and boost our own I fear that the spells that Lurlei and I cast to aid the armies in their fight will be no better than a child's first attempt at spell casting. But I believe there is [hope for us yet].
Lady Eilwen.hope for us yet: I have been working with that Infiltrator, Dory. I know General Wystan thinks poorly of him, but Lady Lile has taken a liking to him. Of course, that may be just to annoy General Wystan, but who knows? Anyway, Dory learned of our magical problems and came to me to discuss the problem. He's been hunting for possible solutions and now it appears that [he has found one].
Lady Eilwen.he has found one: He has sent a note requesting that I come speak to him immediately, but I cannot answer his summons. Lurlei and I have a meeting with General Wystan and Mistress Etheldreda to discuss the progress of our fight. Dory only attends these meetings sporadically, so if he is not there he will not be missed. I, on the other hand, will most definitely be missed, but the note said to come immediately. I am in a bit of a dilemma for the information is too important for me to miss. If only I had someone to [go meet with Dory].

Dory.her little problem: I've been working on solving that problem for her. See, I can do good things, contrary to what Wystan believes! In my, um, profession, I have quite a few contacts. When I heard the rumors that the Inconnu were responsible for Eilwen's failing spells, I asked around and got an answer from a fine Cabalist. She assured me that the Inconnu were not responsible for Eilwen's problems. I bet you think I'm lying, but I'm not! Brishene is an Inconnu and I think she knows what she's talking about. Brishene is not one to lie, even if she is a member of the Guild of Shadows! She identified the cause as Morgana and has begun to [search for a solution].
Dory.search for a solution: Since Eilwen is not here, I guess I'll have to tell you of what Brishene has found so far to help with the solution. She spent good gold getting this information, so keep your mouth closed and your ears open! Long ago, before the coming of the Drakoran, a cabalist named Meical became fed up with the war raging between the three lands. He had seen too many friends and enemies die and it pushed him over the edge of sanity. He became obsessed with creating life, not destroying it. Meical fled the mainland for the Dales of Devwy and built a hall to lock himself away [from the world].
Dory.from the world: Yes, Meical did not want to have any dealings with the people of this world. Instead he set about fulfilling his obsession. Using his magical skills, he began to create new creatures out of rope and wood and metal. But Meical's insanity warped his magic and over time the creatures developed the same insanity that possessed Meical. The creatures rose up and killed Meical, then spread into the surrounding area where they still roam today. But [Brishene discovered] something about those creatures.
Dory.Brishene discovered: The magic that animates them seems to be undimished, unlike the magic of the Avalonians. Brishene doesn't know why, but she's trying her best to find out what's going on. Since you ratted me out to Wystan before, you're going to make up for it now! Brishene thinks there's a sphere of metal [in the creatures] that contains a bit of their magic and she wants to study it.
Dory.in the creatures: Brishene asked me to get the spheres from the forged servants that roam around outside Meical's Hall. She wants two so she can conduct her experiments on them. I need you to go out and get the spheres for Brishene. Wystan is watching me closely so I can't leave the Caer to go do it myself. When you have the spheres, go to Brishene at Wearyall Village. She will be waiting for you there.
Dory.choose one: Now listen closely, for you can only choose one and once you make your choice you can't change your mind. You may choose from one handed [slashing], two handed [crushing], or a [thrusting] polearm a slashing [flexible] weapon, a [long bow], a [quarterstaff], or a [caster staff]?
Dory.caster staff: Here is your Gem Flecked Quarterstaff. Use it well, <Player>.

Brishene.my pendant: It is a pendant that allows me to focus my magic so that I may use it better. Dory wanted to borrow it to show it to Eilwen but some petty thief stole it from him before he could return it to me. I have [tracked its location] but I must begin working right away or I would go retrieve it myself. Every minute I delay hurts Eilwen and the Avalonian armies.
Brishene.tracked its location: Apparently the thief either traded it or lost it to the hands of a Drakoran because I've tracked it to one of their camps. There is a Drakoran there named Barak. My sources tell me that you will find Barak in the camp that lies east from the great tree of Wearyall Hill. I must have that pendant if I am to do my research correctly. I can start without it, but it will be better with it. Return to me when you have my pendant.

Gral Bermorn.switch: As the last rays of light fade from Salisbury, travel to each major druid ring and make use of your crystal. The crystal will be crushed in the process and will activate the ring's well. As Morgana's power has hold of the tombs below these rings, I am unsure what the mix of necromantic power and ley energy will have upon you and the circle itself. Be prepared for anything! If you find yourself without a ley crystal return to a minor circle and use the darkenstone to gain another. If you are foolish enough to lose your darkenstone, you may return to the [ axis circle ] and kill a skeleton to obtain another.
Gral Bermorn.axis circle: All seven of the wells can only be activated using darkness. If dawn arrives and you have not visited all seven you must wait till the next night to complete the ritual. When you have established the alignment of these ley lines, travel to the heart of Stonehenge and use your darkenstone for the final time. Upon the stone's destruction the bonds that tie the portal close should ignite and allow it to be [ opened from the other side ].
Gral Bermorn.opened from the other side: You must be ready for Glasan at this point. When the arch druid arrives, you will have little time to attack him, as his power will grow quickly. If you are successful in slaying him, the staff should shatter on its own. Any shards left from the battle must be returned to me! Here, take these instructions to aid you. Good luck to thee Theurgist.

Eafa Thatcher.misplaced: Yes. I came out here for adventure, wealth and most importantly, new scenery! But what I got were a bunch of [undead nuisances] instead.
Eafa Thatcher.undead nuisances: What? You haven't seen them? Come now, friend! They are all over the beautiful apple orchards here. You surely can't have [missed them], did you? Hrm...
Eafa Thatcher.missed them: Well, even if you did, I know you wouldn't want the undead roaming around your orchards, now would you? I didn't think so. Hey! Maybe you and I could work out some sort of [arrangement]. You help me and I'll help you.
Eafa Thatcher.arrangement: The other locals and I don't want those undead around, but we certainly can't take care of it by ourselves. You have the look of a stalwart defender of Albion. I'll bet that you could help [us] with the undead problem.
Eafa Thatcher.us: I'm sure, in exchange, I could get the other merchants to come up with some money, and maybe a magical item for you. What do you say? Will you [do it]?
Eafa Thatcher.do it: Great! I knew you'd help us out. Now listen, here's what [must be done].
Eafa Thatcher.must be done: We had been in negotiations with a man called Reabus Drakehide who was going to deliver the information we had to a necromancer in Fort Gwyntell. But Reabus disappeared with our money and our information. We need that [information].
Eafa Thatcher.information: Reabus was headed to Fort Gwyntell the last we heard, but that was nigh onto a week ago, and a messenger we sent there brought back word that he never made it. His horse was found roaming the hills halfway to [Caer Gothwaite].
Eafa Thatcher.Caer Gothwaite: We aren't sure why he decided to go straight there instead of to Wearyall, but he must have had a good reason. He mentioned something about a person called Meb, but we don't know who that is. Here, take this coin and purchase a ticket to Caer Gothwaite. When you get there, speak with the Stable Master, Kennard Jameson. He will know if there is anyone name Meb frequents [Gothwaite] or not.

Kennard Jameson.Eafa Thatcher: I figured as much. He's been trying to talk adventurers like you into getting rid of the undead around here for ages. Hehe. He still hasn't succeeded. You'd think he'd [stop trying] by now.
Kennard Jameson.stop trying: Well, I know it isn't a noble thing to do, to give up, but he's met with a lot of failures in this undertaking. It is rather monumental. Still, if there's anything I can do to help, I will. Now, we were [talking] about Reabus, right?
Kennard Jameson.talking: Reabus used to like to hang around one of the kitchen servants, a girl named Hanna. She was pleasing to the eyes, I suppose, but she was beneath his station. Not sure what he saw in her, but maybe you could talk with her first.

Hannah.miss: I know they found his horse halfway here, but I almost wish they had found him too, whether he was dead or alive. At least then I'd know. I know what you're thinking, how could a kitchen girl love a [soldier]?
Hannah.soldier: Reabus has always been so kind to me, ever since we were both children. As the years went on, we both kept in touch, from the time he went in for training as an Armsman, to when he was part of [Constantine's army].
Hannah.Constantine's army: I would get a letter from him every month, telling me of the war that was raging between Albion and Midgard and Hibernia. Sometimes it was too gruesome for me to read, but I always [replied] to his letters.
Hannah.replied: Finally, his last letter to me said he was going to be stationed in Caer Gothwaite for limited duty. So, I left Campacorentin Forest and came here. I knew we would finally [be together].
Hannah.be together: He said being only a part-time soldier made it possible for him to earn extra money on the side, helping local merchants with their caravans and helping others with problems. That's when he heard of [Eafa].
Hannah.Eafa: Eafa has been trying to get rid of the undead for a while now and Reabus knew he could do the job. He kissed me goodbye and left for Caifelle. That was the last I saw of him. He told me that if his old friend [Meb] showed up, to get him a room.
Hannah.Meb: Meb was his second in command during the time he served in the army. He had sent Meb a letter asking him to come and help him, but he said he couldn't wait for a reply. Me is a [sorcerer], capable of many things. Reabus knew he could help out.
Hannah.sorcerer: But I haven't seen Meb. In fact, there hasn't even been a reply from Reabus's letter to him over a month ago. I know Meb lives in Caer Diogel, for whatever that's worth. I'm so sad, I hope I get to see Reabus again!

Meb.prohibited: Captain Denholm thought it would be best if those who could defend the Caer remain here. I send word to Reabus, but it must not have reached him in time.
Meb.Anniogel: Hanna tells me Reabus's mount, <Player>, is still there. There may be some clue to his disappearance. Give this note to Toby Keller, the Stable Master there. He will help you.
Meb.not known them: They were, at one time, allied with the Avalonians, but their help was shunned by the Avalonians when the Drakoran attacked Avalon. Though somewhat discouraged, they would not attack. This must be a [trick].
Meb.trick: Until I can discern more information from these scraps, I'm afraid our search is at a standstill.

Toby Keeler.means: Well, whatever it means, I really hope you find Reabus. He was a good tipper.

Grindan Halig.hidden depths: I am unsure if you know of Iohannes Aldar? He is a respectable arrow merchant up at the Cornwall station. Iohannes is known for his love of adventure. Unfortunately a [grievous injury] forced him to settle and take up fletching.
Grindan Halig.grievous injury: Very serious indeed! Though killed, the greater boogey Iohannes was fighthing took his left foot. Since this time, he has asked to hear the tales of any who pass through Cornwall station. Iohannes has not only become quite the arrow merchant, but also a wealth of knowledge to anyone who would listen to [his story].
Grindan Halig.his story: I recently visited Iohannes and heard a tale that has whet my appetite ever since. It seems some adventurer stumbled upon a new room within the Catacombs of Cardova. The undead that now inhabit the tomb were different than what she had encountered before. These new legions of the emperor [could speak]!
Grindan Halig.could speak: After hearing this, I researched a bit on my own within Camelot. Just two days ago I came to the realization that it may be possible to learn the true identity of the emperor that was buried within the catacombs! Alas, I do not know what effect this may have upon the tomb as a whole, as putting name to the forgotten emperor could lead to greater tomb raiding. Yet, if I could find someone who would be [willing to bear the weight] of this task and do so quietly then perhaps the tomb will remain unchanged.
Grindan Halig.willing to bear the weight: Ah! Very good (class name)! I think you will do nicely. I do not know how best to proceed I suggest that you speak with Iohannes Aldar at Cornwall station. Perhaps if you listen to his story and study the tomb well, you will find the key to [learning] the name of the emperor. Best of luck <Player>!

Iohannes Aldar.lower levels: Not many have returned from this new area, but those who have carry with them fabulous stories. Thier stories speak of a long hall, a hall with a light at the end. Within that light exists a great and powerful undead roman general. I can only imagine what else may lay within this [new found chamber]!
Iohannes Aldar.new found chamber: Yes! I almost forgot to mention the voices! Some spirit that inhabits the passageways about the main chamber speaks continually. This is quite odd as from what I have heard, most spirits and undead are unwilling to speak openly. I would be willing to [pay generously] to have on hand the words that are spoken of this spirit.
Iohannes Aldar.pay generously: Oh! You are offering your services then? This is great (class name)! You must depart immediately then. Travel into the deepest parts of the Catacombs of Cardova. Travel into these newly found chambers and locate the talkative spirit. I will await you here when you have found the words it speaks. Good luck (class name)!

Spirit of the Emperor.waiting many generations: Long ago I ruled all that you see both here and above! The people worshiped me and even Emperor Nero accepted my counsel from time to time. The fools within Rome knew nothing of the land here. If not for thier meddling, my name might be spoken by all even to this day! Now it seems some fool witch has begun to raise my fellow generals and soldiers from thier graves. I have no interest in the events that now transpire above and seek only to [end the torment] she has placed upon me.
Spirit of the Emperor.end the torment: Yes! To exist as an undead is to know pain, a pain so horrible it can only be silenced through a second death. Do you not realize that this is the sole reason why my men continually attack all who trespass within this tomb? Thier only hope is for a swift end to thier awakened state and a return to the [sweet darkness].
Spirit of the Emperor.sweet darkness: This is why you have come to me <Player>! I seek to once more join my brethren in the after-life. Unfortunately the curse that keeps me in this state is intertwined with my generals. Each one must be silenced in turn and thier [focus item] offered up to me within the chamber of cleansing.
Spirit of the Emperor.focus item: From Olivarius will come a scepter, from Taras a sword, from Crotus a seal, and from Amminus an amulet. Each of these focus items with the exception of the last must first be used at this spot before the next one can be obtained. When you have acquired Amminus' amulet, proceed into the crypt of the displaced soul. If the amulet is used at this location my body will be summoned from beneath the crypt. This will be your chance to bestow your gift of silence upon me. Perhaps in my death, the [curse will be broken] and all who still walk within this tomb will be put to rest.

Sister Elaydith.rotthing flesh: Her back was covered with black small oozing sores. I applied a salve to her back and hoped that would be the end of it. I could not have been more wrong. Two days later, she died. Since her death, eight more people have grown ill and two have died. If this plague [continues], everyone in the city will be sick and dying in a matter of weeks. We have to stop it before it's too late. Will you help me ______?
Sister Elaydith.sick: Oh no! You have the early markings of the disease. We have to get you a potion to keep you healthy while we find a [cure].
Sister Elaydith.cure: There is only one thing that seems to do any good and I have run out of it. I need you to quickly go into Dartmoor and find a creature called a Dartmoor Pony. I need you to bring me the horse fungus that comes from that creature so I can use it to cast a special cure spell on you. Go quickly before you start showing signs of the illness.
Sister Elaydith.Marquis Sabonach: This is not the first time I have heard that name. Others have whispered it to me. I have [learned] where it comes from.
Sister Elaydith.learned: Sabonach is the name of a demon that lives in an underground fortress called Darkness Falls. Legends say that the Marquis lives in the darkest depths of that hellish place. The entrance can be found in our relic keeps, but the mythical gate only opens when our forces have conqured more lands than the other realms. Otherwise, the entrance remains closed. There are rumors of another gateway very close to Camelot City, which may be used in a suprise attack against us. That place is pure evil, ______, but I fear you will need to go there and find a [cure] for the disease.
Sister Elaydith.Albion: He informed the king that Sir Bors is planning some sort of an assassination against the Crown. He also said that the demon named Marquis [Sabonach] was spreading the disease that is afflicting Camelot City
Sister Elaydith.Sabonach: I did some research of my own and found the name of another creature in Darkness Falls that may hold the cure. There is a creature called Malroch. He is said to be the cook of Darkness Falls. He cooks up recipes made from the fruit of immortality. If you could bring me just one of his sealed wondrous potions, I am sure I could come up with a cure for the [disease]. You could keep any extra potions you find for yourself.
Sister Elaydith.disease: He might be our only chance, ______, If not, I am sure that Camelot City will soon fall to this horrible disease and after that, all of Albion. You must find the way into Darkness Falls before it is too late.
Sister Elaydith.hellish: This one potion should be more than enough. You can keep the other potion for yourself. It's a very powerful potion, so use it when in dire straights. I must begin to cure the other stricken people. You have earned a friend for life, ______. I shall remember your name if I am ever in need of help again.
Sister Elaydith.begin: Shortly after I saw you last, I was called to a meeting by the King's council to tell them all I knew about the plague you helped me stop. I learned about more weird reports of...well things that are hard to describe. It seems that strange creatures have been [scouting] around Albion.
Sister Elaydith.scouting: Just last week, in Campocorentin Station, one of the town guards reported that he slew a shadowy creature that he happened to surprise while it was writing notes on a map. The map showed where all the city guards stood throughout the day. It also showed the location of the town's healer, smith and enchanter. The map showed things that can only be seen by someone [studying] the town for a very long time.
Sister Elaydith.studying: I overheard some of the council members whispering about a plot to attack the station. That could explain why the creature was making maps. There has been some other [reports].
Sister Elaydith.reports: Villagers in Humberton became suddenly ill after drinking the water from a nearby well. When the guards checked the well, they found that someone had dropped a small bottle of [poison] into it.
Sister Elaydith.poison: It was no accident either. The bottle was crafted with tiny holes in it to slowly leak the viscous (vicious?) poison into the water. That way more people would drink from the well before becoming ill. Who knows how many lives would have been lost if the guards had not acted so swiftly. There are also reports of hundreds of people suffering from a strange [haunting dream].
Sister Elaydith.haunting dream: They said the dream always starts the same. It starts with a strange woman wearing garments that look something like Cleric's clothes. She seems very upset about something and then she ventures into a very evil dungeon. She seems to be looking for someone and then she was suddenly slain and her spirit captured. The demons that capture her begin to taunt her and say that she is one of the first spirits they have captured intact. Then they mock her and say they have [special plans] for her.
Sister Elaydith.special plans: They give her spirit to the succubus so they can cast spells upon her and change her into one of them. Her spirit begins calling out for help and that is where the dream ends. The dream must be very haunting. Many of those having it, soon set off in search of the dungeon to see if they can somehow rescue the woman's [spiritand] are never seen or heard from again.
Sister Elaydith.directly: One night a small imp scared a villager half witless by popping out of his fireplace and speaking to him. The imp told him his name was Mystemas and to seek you out and have you meet him in Darkness Falls. The imp said he had a secret to pass to the king and he would only speak it to those brave enough to go against the lecherous gress. The villager told the nearest guard and word made its way to the [Council].
Sister Elaydith.Council: The King's Council and the Church debated back and forth about the wisdom of sending anyone into Darkness Falls to meet with a demon and we finally agreed to disagree. The Council asks that you journey into Darkness Falls and meet with this imp to see if he truly has any valuable information. I find this deplorable, but we are bound by the Council's decision. Will you do this for the council? Do you accept this mission from the Council? [Level 45] Accept or Decline
Sister Elaydith.Level 45: You are a brave soul, <Player>. No one from the Church would ever consider stepping foot into that hellish place. Demons should be destroyed, not bargained with. I should hold my tongue, but I believe you are walking into some sort of twisted [trap].
Sister Elaydith.trap: The imp may simply be trying to lure you back into Darkness Falls so the foul creatures may have their revenge against you. In any case, you should be very careful and not trust a thing the imp says. I wish you luck, my friend, and a safe journey. [Step 2]Travel to the Albion entrance of Darkness Falls, and speak with an imp named Mystemas.

Berenger Brennar.Sister Elaydith: Very well. I am watching over [Gaevin] ensuring sure he is well enough to tend to his duties.
Berenger Brennar.Gaevin: Aye. He has been feeling ill lately, yet he refuses to rest. I keep telling him that he needs to drink water and sleep. He is as stubborn as a mule and has never listened a day in his life. Every time I tell him to go rest, he just says I should mind my own business. He is in a lot of [pain] and I think he wants to see his brother, Keener, for something.
Berenger Brennar.pain: Well I know you didn't come all this way just to chat with me. You should go speak with Gaevin now, while he is in a good mood. He normally doesn't chat much with strangers, especially ones with questions prying about his health.
Berenger Brennar.demons: He tried to cut me in half with a sword until I pinned him against the wall. I felt so bad because I know the sores on his back hurt so much, but it was the only way to keep him from [killing me].
Berenger Brennar.killing me: I have heard stories of other sick people killing Clerics because they were so sick they thought the Cleric was a demon. You need to go back to Sister Elaydith that Gaevin's time is near. I don't think he will live much longer without a cure.

Gaevin Sebryn.sick: I have heard rumors spreading around the city about people falling ill, but the guards are keeping a tight lip if you ask them what is happening. I think the king is trying to keep this sickness a secret so people don't panic. Can I tell you my own [secret]?
Gaevin Sebryn.secret: I am really scared, ______. I am putting a brave face on so that the city guard, Berenger, doesn't lock me up. I don't think I will live to see the next full moon. Can you do me a [favor], ______?'
Gaevin Sebryn.favor: I need a message delivered to my hometown so they know what is going on. If I die, I don't want them to think I left home because of them. I just needed to get out and see the world, [understand]?
Gaevin Sebryn.understand: I am sure you do. You seem the adventurous sort yourself. Now take this sealed letter to my brother, Keener, in Ludlow. He will make sure my parents get it. Tell him not to worry about me. He will know something is wrong when he gets my letter because I haven't tried to wrote to my parents in years. [Hopefully], the cleric will find a cure before you return.
Gaevin Sebryn.Hopefully: If not, I may not be hear to learn of any news you bring back. Now get out of here! I am tired of looking at your ugly mug.
Gaevin Sebryn.feeling: I can't lie down to sleep anymore. It causes so much pain if I touch the sores. I am getting sicker and I am so scared. A [strange man] came to visit me while you were gone.
Gaevin Sebryn.strange man: He was dressed in long robes and said he was Marquis Sabonach. That man did not look like a noble at all. He whispered some strange words in my ear and said I would be [ok].
Gaevin Sebryn.ok: He lied. I even feel worse than yesterday. My body hurts too much for me to try lying down again. I don't know what I am going to do. I hope the Healer has a cure for me soon. Could you ask Berenger if he has heard anything yet? I know Berenger thiks I have lost my mind but I am fooling him. Tehe haha.

Keenar Woedin.favor: Go back to Camelot and give this note to Gaevin. I realize that it must be quite the journey for you and you are not a messenger, but I must insist that you help me get that [message] to my brother.
Keenar Woedin.message: Gaevin may die before he finds out my parents don't hate him for leaving Ludlow. That is why it is so important to me to have him get my message. I have a few gold coins if you need them. Do you [need them] or [not]?
Keenar Woedin.not: Thank you, ______. I will put the coin to good use. It will help pay for my parents to travel to [Camelot City].
Keenar Woedin.Camelot City: Aye, you must get going. Thank you so much, ______. You shall be blessed for your deeds this day.

Juliana Grym.understand: About the feeling I have, that our peace is disturbed. Sometimes, I feel like I shouldn't be here at all. But there is more. Sometimes I sense strange beings that I can't quite make out. I sense them in the house. They make me [angry].
Juliana Grym.angry: Yes. Unsettled, angry. I try to keep my calm, but they are a constant pressure. And things are already so confusing! For instance, why hasn't Lucia gone to market? She should have gone to [market], yet she hasn't gone in so long.
Juliana Grym.market: Well. She can't remember when she went. Neither can any of us. But it couldn't have been long ago. Things are [strange], <Player>. Will you help us?'

Everard Grym.bothered: Anxious. Angry. Annoyed. What not. What do you want? Oh. Juliana sent you.Didn't she.Fine. You are here. Have you seen anything strange? Odd? Different? We all feel different. Have you seen strange [presences]?
Everard Grym.presences: Aye.Can you? Can't you? Well. Stick around. They come. They always do. I know not what they are. There was a holy man. Father Staverly. He stayed on the hill. He came to us often. Seek him out. Ask him what to do about the Grym family! Tell him the presences disturb us. I think he now stays at Fort Gwyntell, beyond the hill behind our homes.

Father Staverly.forces: Those of Morgana, wicked sorceress and mistress of dragons; and those of Arawan, the dark lord of the underworld. Since Arawn's forces broke the boundries between the mortal and immortal to aid us against Morgana, I can only think it must be Morgana's doing, perhaps one of her minions. The only way to undo the workings of necromancers these days seem to be by accepting the aid of other [necromancers].
Father Staverly.necromancers: Seek out a drakoran mystic. They wear charms of some sort, we call them charms of the dead. Bring these charms to the priest of Arawan at Fort Gwyntell in exchange for a sword, a dark sword of Arawan. Give this to Warin. He was once a great Paladin.

Master Xavier.Ogre Citadel: Yes, the ogres. Once, they were allies. Now, they are a sensitive bunch, blaming us for their essential exile into the mountains and their last stronghold. They fled before Morgana, pleading with us for aid, not realizing that we were already defeated, fleeing before the evil [Drakoran] hoardes.
Master Xavier.Drakoran: Aye. We weren't the sole occupants on this island you know. Once, not long ago, as we measure time, the ogres were our allies. We held this land together minding our own business, for the most part. We helped each other out occasionally. Occasionally we had some arguements that turned into some fighting, but nothing much. Then, Morgana came, and pushed us back, and the ogres back, [as well].
Master Xavier.as well: They wanted us to help them. They somehow expected us to do a better job of defending the island. Truthfully, I think they rallied themselves to late, and relied on us too heavily. They liked to keep to themselves, and when Morgana's Drakoran hoarde appeared and she summoned that dragon up, while we were struggling to hold our city, they [retreated] to their fortresses and citadels.
Master Xavier.retreated: They watched as our city became overrun. They watched the citizens of Avalon flee. But they assumed we'd handle it. The assumed they were not threatened. Then, the Drakorans [surprised] the ogres.
Master Xavier.surprised: Honestly, I don't see how they could have been surprised. It was clear to all of us what was happening. Morgana wanted the island, wanted it's magic. Ogres have access to the powerful places in the land. They have [magic] all their own.
Master Xavier.magic: Oh yes, Powerful magic. Ogre magic. I know a bit about their [strange] magic.
Master Xavier.strange: Oh yes. Here, we face the Drakorans and Morgana's evil. But what of when they are gone? Then, we are faced with the threat of that savage people from the Norse lands. If Albion does not defeat Midgard, then Midgard will defeat us. Now, if Albion got a hold of some of the magic of the ogres in their most powerful [stronghold], think what could be done!
Master Xavier.stronghold: Well now, before I go telling you about all that, I need to know, would you be willing to find some of their magic? You will need help, a lot of help. So before you agree, be sure you can convince many friends to come along. It's an orb I'm looking for, created by one called the Star [Channeler]; and it's locked deep inside the Ogre Citadel.

Arden.power: Rory says the ogres don't have magic, and that this one Ogre, he was talking about natural powers that had more to do with a science of application rather than spells and incantations! How absurd, I say! Let the ogres believe what they will, but I know magic, and what this self-claimed star channeler does is not [science] but magic.
Arden.science: Science. Call it what you will. Here is what Rory says happens. There is a room inthe citadel under the stars. There are four golden rings. Rory said the star channeler, named Scurceol Hyrde, calls them nodes. The nodes are powerful. The seem to protect the star channeler. His name is Scurceol Hyrde. I don't pretend to konw how it all works. I can't even tell you how to defeat Scurceol Hyrde, but I know the room is very [dangerous].
Arden.dangerous: Rory only said the room meant death for anyone not meant to enter. The nodes, he says, semms to be collecting power from the stars! He said storms often brew in the room. He says the ogre that calls himself the star channeler wields lightening! Now, it won't be easy getting in to this chamber, but if you want, I know who has a [map] to the chamber!
Arden.map: The ogre Malefact. He holds a map. I know this because Rory has tried to obtain this map. Normally, I would get Rory to sneak in, but Rory is missing, lost somewhere in the ogre fortress! Ah, but kill Malefact, and you will have your map. The map will guide you to the star channeler's chamber.

Lady Lurlei.something for you: This is one of the few items I was able to save as we left the city of Avalon when the Drakoran attacked. I have been holding on to it for a while in hopes of finding the right person to give it to, and now I have. Thank you, <Player>. Your service to Avalon is highly appreciated!

Samwell Hornly.certain: I seek unused arrowheads from the tylwyth teg rovers. I think that I can add them to my arrow shafts and make some new arrows. Have you ever noticed how the arrows from those hunters seem to slice right through platemail? I think I could make similar arrows and sell them to the border guards. Bring me as many unused [arrowheads] as you can.

Brach Leof.learning to track: Recently I followed some interesting tracks in the Pennine Mountains, but I was forced to turn back before I found my prey. The tracks led me to believe I was tracking a [wild chicken]!" However, I also found scales, so I'm not sure what it was.
Brach Leof.wild chicken: If you want to see if you can find some of the feathers of these scaled chickens I'd be most interested. Bring back proof of their existence so I know I was right in my [assumptions].

Mystemas.looking: What? Are you as stupid as you look? Maybe not, eh. You come down here with big ideas and try to do good deeds. I say the faster you go get yourself killed, the better. Wait a [second]!
Mystemas.second: You are that idiot who killed Malroch. Hehe, that was pretty foolish of you. Everyone in Darkness Falls has heard of you and is looking to cash in on the [bounty] for your head.
Mystemas.bounty: What? Do you think mortals are the only ones who use bounties? Any demon that slays you is supposed to be rewarded by the Master, but I have seen how he rewards his followers. I used to be one of the strongest demons in the Master's army and now look at me. The Master changed me into an imp as [punishment] for something I had nothing to do with.
Mystemas.punishment: How was I supposed to know the Master already had a plan? Anyway now I am really upset and I need your help to get some revenge on a few demons. If you help me I will tell you things that may just keep you alive a tad longer in the future. Let's say I know something about an ambassador that has been helping the lands of Albion to an early [demise].
Mystemas.demise: I thought that might get your attention, but before I start telling what I know, I want some proof that you can handle yourself in battle. After all, you might have just been lucky when you beat the poor old Malroch. I want you to sneak into the area where the dragon of your land sleeps and return with something for me. You do this for me and I will tell you something of what I [know].
Mystemas.know: Let's see. What should I have you get, eh? I know! I want a granite gem from a granite giant stonebreaker living in southwestern [Dartmoor]. They dig up some very interesting gems in those mountains.
Mystemas.Dartmoor: If you are wondering if you can trust me, don't worry your mind any longer. You can trust me, and I can't trust you. That keeps things simple in our future dealings. Now bring me what I want and stop wasting my time. [Step 3] Journey to southwestern Dartmoor and retrieve Granite Gem from a granite giant stonebreaker. Killed Granite Giant Stonebreaker at Dartmoor loc=11k 43k, got gem. Back to Mystemas in DF.
Mystemas.Step 3: Oh, you are back. I suppose you have what I asked for?
Mystemas.threat: This was done to increase the casualties on both sides of your stupid war. Each time a mortal falls in combat, we take a small portion of that creature's spirit and create one of the soultorn that roam deeper in Darkness Falls. The soultorn are then trained to fight in my Master's armies. See the brilliance of this [plan]?
Mystemas.plan: The more you fight, the more you die. The more you die, the stronger we get. Hehe, very nice eh? Master also has a method to get the freshest and strongest of your [spirits].
Mystemas.spirits: He watches which of your three realms is strongest on the field of battle and then allows only that realm to directly enter Darkness Falls. We can make far stronger soultorn from those that die here. In fact, once in a while we get very lucky and trap an entire creature's spirit here. There has been an especially strong [soultorn] captured recently.
Mystemas.soultorn: She was a foolish healer named Caisha who came here looking for her lost friend. Now our Princess is torturing her spirit so we can make it into a succubi. Prince Ba'alorian wants to use her in his army as a high priestess or something. Wait, I have an [idea].
Mystemas.idea: You might be able to help both of us at the same time. The Ambassador normally stays at the Princess's side. You will need proof to take to your king that he is being lied to and the Ambassador should be carrying plans from the Prince that will help convince your king. You can help me by taking [Caisha's spirit].
Mystemas.Caisha's spirit: If the Prince has her for a high priestess, I doubt I will ever get a chance to gain my Master's favor again. I would surely like to see the Prince's plan fail miserably and you would provide me the means to do that. So let me make it clear what you [need to do].
Mystemas.need to do: First, slay the ambassador and get his pouch of documents to take back to your king or whatever. Second, slay the Princess and her followers. You mst then slay Caisha's soultorn to release her spirit from its torment. Take this Soulstone. It will capture Caisha's spirit when she is slain so that no other demon captures her. Oh, one other [thing].
Mystemas.thing: If you get captured, I will do everything within my power to ensure the inquisitors shred every last piece of your spirit before you can tell anyone our little plan. Do you [Understand] me?
Mystemas.Understand: Good. Now get going before someone sees us talking. Lasairiona.nonsensical phrases: The elders of our class, and the others that follow our Path believe the Map Sprite is an oracle of sorts. An insane one, perhaps, but his message must be [discovered]. Speak with this Map Sprite, and see what you can glean from him.
Lasairiona.knowledge: Aye. I thought so. Well, an old woman like me can't survive long on her own, being to old to practice the trade of my youth. [Knowledge] is my only trade now. The price is four rat tails.

For every hundred years that passes in the land of men, only a day passes for Caithor. He wanders the land, seeking out a child of Duana and Edan destined to retrieve the Moonstone. This will break the enchanetment Duana placed on him. Some say he seeks Fagan's death as well. *the Moonstone:

Ciarda.tap into the same magic: He has had some success, although it is difficult to tell since he is not here to test it upon the plants and animals of this land. I have tested some of the spells he has developed, but since I possess the magic naturally, I am not a good judge. Torrance and I have come up with [a solution to this problem].
Ciarda.a solution to this problem: The magic should work upon plants and animals of this land, but they have become far to wild to take to Hibernia safely. I believe that if we are able to get a root from a tendril weed, Torrance will be able to nurture it until it grows into a tendril weed he can use. As for the animals, Torrance said he doesn't actually need a live creature to work with, just [some part of it].
Ciarda.some part of it: I know it is not the most pleasant thought, but it will do the job. If it means that he will know if he is truly drawing upon the magic of Hy Brasil, it is worth it. Once you get the root from the tendril weed, seek out a callow forest grazer. You'll need to get a hoof from it. That will be enough for Torrance to work with. Now, go and seek out a tendril weed. When you have everything, return to me here.

There was a time when most of the magic we used was for simply shaping our homes and becoming closer to nature. Now, though, it seems we use our magic and our affinity with plants to defend. I know that the Druids and Wardens and Bards feel a desire to protect nature. As animists, we believe we should be nature. It is a hard thing to achieve, but it is what we believe. Crace.enchanted silver: Aye, <Player>, it's mainly controlled by those evil siabra local to the area, however, I've a friend who has managed to get a large amount of the silver. See, we've come up with a trade. The next boat leaves for Hibernia shortly, and I don't have the time to go and get everything to trade myself.
