Mirari.pouches missing: The other night I caught side of a lesser sylvanshade leaving here carrying something brown. I believe it had one of my seed pouches. The lesser sylvanshades never bothered us before the Fomorian came, but their evil presence has disturbed many creatures of the wood, including the sylvanshades. I fear the Fomorian may have even coerced the sylvanshades into stealing the seeds to prevent we Sylvan from restoring the groves. I would go out and search for the thief myself, but i must guard the chests and tend to some delicate seedlings. You must go now and search for the lesser sylvanshade that has the stole seed pouch. Return to me when you have retrieved it. [Step #2] Find a lesser sylvanshade and get the pouch of seeds from it. They can be found northwest of the entrance to the Grove of Domnann. The lesser sylvanshades are everywhere round the Grove so go, kill one and retrieve the pouch. [Step #3] Return to Miari in the Grove of Domnann.
Mirari.Step #3: ***! I am pleased to see you have returned. Were you able to retrieve the pouch from the sylvanshade? Please, i must check the seeds.
Mirari.for their safety: Shortly after I planted them, I noticed some tracks around the seedlings. Then yesterday morning, as the sun's rays touched the leaves and filled the world with warmth, I went to the grove of seedlings. I was saddened by what I saw. Many of the seedlings had been dug up! Their delicate roots had been ripped from the ground and their tender leaves eaten. Out of the corner of my eye, I [saw the creatures] I belieave are responsible for this horrible act!
Mirari.saw the creatures: A pair of forest grazer calves slunk off into the trees. I am sure that they are the creatures that are tearing up my seedlings and feasting upon them. Before the Fomorian came, the calves never bothered the seedlings but ate the grass instead. I fear that the change in their habits has been caused by the evil of the Fomorian. Some of these seedlings are the last of their kind. You must [protect them]!
Mirari.protect them: Go now and seek out the forest grazer calves. I know you cannot stop all of them, but stopping two of them would help a great deal. I do not like to deal with creatures in this manner, but I must protect my trees at all costs! If they have any of my seedlings, bring them back to me and I shall try to save them. I wish you luck.

Tadhg.adventure: Great! I have lost something that is important to me, an item my mother gave me when I was young. It was taken from me in the middle of the night. I noticed some [footprints] outside my window the next morning.
Tadhg.footprints: Aye, they matched those of the beach rats around here, but with all that's been [happening] lately I haven't had a chance to search for it. Do you think you have the time to help me get it back?
Tadhg.check: Thanks <Player>. I know you will find the locket for me.

Adair.choose a path: If you dread traveling far, please [tell me now], or you will find yourself running quite a bit. There are three Paths to choose from: The [Path of Essence], the [Path of Harmony], and the [Path of Focus]. Not all paths may be open to you.
Adair.Path of Focus: Very well then. No need tosend you all the way to Ardagh! Speak will Cadalind, at the Guard Tower on the road North, from outside Howth. She will explain the Path of Essence.

Keriann.hamlet: Oh! Another one wanting to know about the Path of Harmony, eh? Well, I'm not a Mentalist, but I've studied their ways. Mentalists draw strength from understanding that everything works together, that the magical world and the non-magical world are really the same world. There is a balance between magic and non-magic. It's only when both are used together that there is harmony. Now, go speak with Cadalind, at the guard tower, to learn of the Path of Focus. <Player>, <Player>, I know you already spoke with her, but I've not studied the path Eldritches follow.

Ula.Path of Focus: Speak with either Blathnaid in Tir na Nog, or Leachlainn, in Ardagh, south on the road outside of Ardee, North from Howth, to learn about the Path of Essence.
Ula.have time: I realize you are recent to this area, and may not know the locals or the land, but I [appreciate] it. Could you deliver a letter to a merchant for me? Dialog box: Will you deliver this letter for me?
Ula.the favor: Deliver this letter to Dirmyg. He's usually found at the merchant shops across from the guard tower on the road south toward Tir na mBeo. If he's feeling talkative, he might even tell you about the Caoranoch.

Miach.hunt: Aye. It is not their normal way. I believe it is the evil touch of the Fomorians! They have ruined the homes of many of these creatures, they have destroyed their hunting grounds, and now, some of the creatures have become twisted and [abhorrent]! The beasts I speak of, close to our town, the lungers, we must get ird of them! Dialog box: Will you help rid the area of young lungers?
Miach.sylvanshades: The [sylvanshades] are strange creatures of darkness. They exist opposite the Sylvan, but where the Sylvan are nurturing, they are destructive. Liisu wants help protecting the groves.
Miach.disturbed: I'm not sure what it is, but Liisu would like our help [again].
Miach.Path of Affinity: Yes, it has always been our way, to start out as the Way of the Grove, and then follow the Path of [Affinity], when we are ready. You do have a choice in your path, however.

Resalg.formula: Aye. It will calm down the maddened animals, I think. I can't truly be sure, but I'm hoping so! Some of the animals have even been mutated, since the Fomorian's arrival, you know. I blame the foulness of that maleficent race! I would like to aid the Sylvan, I would like to see this ravaged land restored, and the peaceful balance that has taken generations upon generations to develop, once again restored. Aye, and I'll not lie, but I'm willing to bet I'd have a name, if I were to aid the process in some way! Maybe some prestige! Ah, but to work, yes, to work now. Here, I shall pay you for this tail! Good day, friend!

Dirmyg.other business: Ah you are here to deliver a letter? I am expecting one from Tir na mBeo. May I have the letter?

Searlait.under her care: Some of the seedlings have gotten too big for her to keep inside, so she has planted them outside the walls of the Grove. Mirari told me that out there she will be able to keep an eye on the seedlings until they are stronger. Once they are strong enough, she and others will take them to their permanent homes in new groves. We shall help the Sylvans [protect thoses groves] from the evil of the Fomorian.
Searlait.protect thoses groves: Mirari needs help now protecting the seedlings so they can grow into the great trees you see around us now. She has asked for your help again, for she fears there is some evil afoot in her newly planted groves. Will you [go to her] and help her again?

Troya.have time: Excellent! I have been doing some research into the local wildlife here and have come up with some rather amazing results. I have but [two more items] I need to complete my research to present to Cathbad.
Troya.two more items: Yes, are you ready to get [started]?
Troya.tibia: Yes, friend. The tibia is one of the arm bones on a person. It is thought that anything relating to the arm means strength. I would like to discern the magical properties of an undead's bone. Return to me when you have it.

Merle the Old.will speak: Aye, more visitors than I've had in years! More than I've wanted in years, or still want.
Merle the Old.Blaieseach: Ah yes, He seeks the Moonstone, rumored to be in Lough Derg. It's a powerful item of enchantment. If ye seek it, be careful, for many seek it. If you do find it, then beware, for Blaieseach will then seek you with his trackers.

Fuinshata.knowledge: Aye. I thought so. Well, an old woman like me can't survive long on her own, being to old to practice the trade of my youth. [Knowledge] is my only trade now. The price is four rat tails.
Fuinshata.the Moonstone: Caithor is the Champion responsible for the enchantment placed on Edan. Duana, in retribution, placed her own enchantment on Caithor. For every hundred years that passes in the land of men, only a day passes for Caithor. He wanders the land, seeking out a child of Duana and Edan destined to retrieve the Moonstone. This will break the enchanetment Duana placed on him. Some say he seeks Fagan's death as well. *the Moonstone:

Liisu.disturbing: Yes. The grove trees just aren't growing right! Some of them seem to be growing toward a malformed state! I'm not sure what it is! We don't think it's another form of magic interfering with it, since we can't detect any. We don't even know if it's intentional! But it's hurting the groves, and interfering with our magic! We've got to stop it! I've gone to [Aapo], for his help!
Liisu.Aapo: Yes, Aapo is the Druid envoy, sent to help us from the Druid Court. He's worked on a way to help us locate the source of all the disruption. He said I should send you to him. He will tell you how you can help.

Aapo.Liisu: Ah, is it wonderful to be here, <Player>, amongst the [Sylvan]?
Aapo.Sylvan: Right. The groves are being disturbed somehow, and nobody knows how. I've seen this sort of thing before, though, and may have an idea of what's going on. You see, a long time ago, nature in Hibernia got twisted. All things were affected; plantsm animals, and even us, the Celts! Sometimes, the land reacts to evil. It senses evil, and occasionally, the result is an [abomination] of what is normal.
Aapo.abomination: Nature became twisted. Creatures turned malevolent. The very trees turned horrific creatures of destruction. This was a very long time ago, and even still, some of these creatures remain! I believe the evil of the fomorian has done this to the creatures of Hy Brasil. I believe that one of these [twisted] creatures may be somehow disturbing the balance between the natural magic of the groves and the natural magic of the Sylvan.
Aapo.twisted: I've fashioned this item for you. Wear it, and seek out any of the creatures of the area. When the necklace starts glowing, you will know you are near. I would like to give you a greater idea of what you seek, but I can't. Wear the necklace. It will [guide] you.
Aapo.guide: I do believe the tangleweeds may be disturbing the groves. Perhaps they are digging into the roots of the grove trees. If I am correct, I will need two of the tangle weeds, to study.
Aapo.instructions: Ah. Well, I've learned that not only tangleweeds, but lost shrillers, have been affecting the groves! Well, others have helped me with the lost shrillers. Did you spread the [magical seeds]?
Aapo.magical seeds: Great! I heartily thank you. It's been a rough time, what with the tangleweeds spreading! Here, take this coin, it should aid you. Again, I thank you. Now the grove trees will have a better chance of growing!

Mandra.bad: I recently fell in with the [wrong crowd].
Mandra.wrong crowd: Those villainous youths out there, well, they are my friends...used to be my friends. Not really friends, though, if you ask me. We were doing some terrible things! Stealing, lying...All manner of [ill deeds]!
Mandra.ill deeds: Yes. My parents found out and I realized what I had been doing. I was so ashamed. I told the leader that I wasn't going to come back and be part of that group anymore, but she said she'd [hurt me] if I didn't stay with them.
Mandra.hurt me: I stay here because I know they won't come close to Mag Mell. They are afraid of Fagan and the guards, so I'm safe here, for the time being. But I know everyday they get [braver and braver].

Kyrilean.experiment: Aye, I think I have discovered a way to make comfortable and stylish armour, but I'm afraid people around here would look [down] on me if they knew what I needed to make it.
Kyrilean.down: You see those lough wolf cadgers? Their pelts make for excellent armor, if you can believe it. With this new tanning process I have been working on, it is lighter, more durable, and softer than any other [hide] I have ever worked with.
Kyrilean.hide: Therein lies my problem, <Player>. You see, there are folks here in Mag Mell that are trying to save the little beasts, if you can believe that. If they saw me kill one, they would go absolutely insane with fury. That's why I need you to [help me out].
Kyrilean.help me out: I'd like for you to get me a lough wolf cadger pelt. You are anonymous enough that no one will care. Do you think you can do that for me?
Kyrilean.item: What I need now is a rock chert from a mudman. I can use the chert to smooth out the pelt and make the leather supple. Find a mudman and get the chert for me.

Mannix.magical stuff: Well see, these three, they aren't like the others. One's super strong, the other is said to be as quick as anything and the third is said to be quick witted. So, it's got to be magic. I bet that one of your skill could overcome these creatures. I bet you could overcome one of them in their lair, if you're [interested]. So, I'm telling you, you kill one of these spraggon, there's bound to be praise, and a prize.

Tethra.many more: Have you their heads then? I will pay you for each head, friend, if you give them to me. Or have you [no more heads]? You have done a great thing in killing these spraggon. They are horrible. They run through the land, tearing up good fields, destroying.
Tethra.no more heads: There is said to be an item of magical enchantment on the spraggon you killed, the large one. You didn't mention it. Perhaps you didn't find it? He may have hidden it somewhere. That's what they normally do. Could you please search for this enchanted item? I have a personal interest in it. I believe it would be hidden by the bridge on the road to Druim Ligen.

Ignius.seen: Ah, yes. There are many, aren't there? Hibernia is a realm filled with the impossible! As you age, you will see even more [fantastical] creatures, ones you never thought were possible.
Ignius.get the items: Here is what I need... First you must get a set of eirebug eyes for me. The eirebugs are on that hill, to the southeast of here. Slay one to get its eyes. Next, I will nee the carapace of a [water beetle collector].
Ignius.water beetle collector: You can find the water beetle collectors near the shore by Mag Mell, to the east of here. Watch out for the water beetles, though. They may come to aid the collectors. When you have these items, return to me.

Evan.you: Hehe, I can see it in your eyes that you're ready for some adventure! Excellent! Here's a note of grave importance that I must get you to take to Meara in [Mag Mell].
Evan.Mag Mell: Ah, you must indeed be young. Here are my [directions]. Follow the road out of town, make sure to head south. In the distance you'll see some towers, that is Mag Mell. Meara is a guard there, she's wearing green armour. Good luck!

Meara.letter: Here it is. Thank you so much. Please take this for your trouble. I do so appreciate your helping me with this.

Cristin.make the armor: Oh, I do wish I had the talent, but alas, it is my cousin that makes the actual armor, as well as repairs items that have been damaged or worn. I assist him by collecting the [necessary items] he needs.
Cristin.necessary items: He uses things like hides, pelts, and other parts of animals in his repairs. I have recently received word he is in need of more supplies, but I have no one to take over my shop for me. I am [in need] of someone to retrieve items for me.
Cristin.in need: I am so pleased you have agreed to help me. I will tell you the things I need, and if you are able to retrieve them all, I will pay you well. There are [three things] on the list my cousin sent me.
Cristin.three things: All three things can be found either around Connacht (sic) . The first object sound strange, but it is what he has requested. I need you to get some warts from the hill toads. They are easy enough to get, don't you think? Now, for item [number two] .
Cristin.number two: My cousin has requested that I obtain for him a set of wings from a water beetle. I know I've seen them around here in Connacht. They shouldn't be too difficult to get. Now for the [third item] .
Cristin.third item: I know what he uses this third item for. Spraggonite hides make wonderful patches in torn leather. Please get a hide from a [spraggonite] either here in Connacht or in Silvermine Mountains. Once you have all three items, return to me here.

Raine.elven beings: Aye. They are evil. Many in Hibernia have had unpleasant dealings with them. Even more have been killed by them. It would be worth your time to learn as much about them as you can. I know a bit about them, but the locals, they would know more. See, I am new to this area, and my knowledge of the unseelie court is more historical impartial observance than anything else. I am not an [adventurer], though. You, however, are, and I think you'll discover how important it is to know as much as you can about the unseelie court. Beware though, the locals may demand you show your loyalty to Hibernia with the blood of these evil creatures.

Lavena.unseelie court: Well, I may know why they occupy some of Lough Derg. But I won't be sharing that knowledge with those that aren't willing to take up the fight against the unseelie court. I know they're powerful, I know some feel it pays more to stay on their good side. But I'll not talk with those not willing to fight the evil of the unseelie court. If you wish this knowledge, you must return to me with some of the uncut stones the dergan furys occasionally pick up. You can find dergan furys in the woods northeast of the farm building by the parthanan field.
Lavena.occupy: Most of Lough Derg was once Tir na mBeo. There are the ruins of a tower here in Lough Derg, they are the ruins of the Tower of Tir na mBeo. I won't tell the story of that tower, for it is common in Hibernia. When the unseelie court flooded Hibernia, some of them overran Lough Derg and began to occupy some areas. They have been here so long, that even though they are members of the unseelie court, the natives of Hibernia began to call them dergans. It's a way to [distinguish] the unseelie court.
Lavena.distinguish: The dergans sole interest seems to bein retrieving the lost treasures of the Tower of Tir na mBeo. You could imagine the unseelie court's surprise when they reached the Tower of Tir na mBeo, to find that the once great Elven construct had fallen, and worse, that most of the treasures of the Tower were gone! So they stay here, to seek the treasures, and to search for clues that could lead them to the whereabouts of the treasures. Understand, now, that some of these treasures are items of magic more powerful than anything the unseelie court or the elves now have! As for the rest of the unseelie court, well, they spread our throughout the land. If you travel to Howth, I'm sure you can learn about the unseelie court that has settled in that area. Just talk to the locals.

Aziliz.willingness: Great. Go talk to Chief Bran Llyr. I think he knows quite a bit about the gurites and siabra. He lives in Culraid, in Lough Gur, with Kimba. He may know why the gurites stick around that area.
Aziliz.threaten: Yes, threaten. They are outspoken revolutionsists who desire to see the Elves and Lurikeen shoved from the Veil, to be forever lost from the world of Magic... We must [fight] against this. Are you with me?

Tressa Gorrym'jiarg.price: There is a creature, one who annoys me greatly, of decent power and mind boggling insanity. He fancies himself a great paladin for Albion, and does much damage to the harmless creatures of Bri Leith. The Empyreans being ill-equiped to deal with such a monster, have done nothing to aid me in my efforts to finally rid Hibernia of this nuisance once and for all. If you [agree to help] me, I shall give the cloth to you willingly.
Tressa Gorrym'jiarg.agree to help: Excellent! I knew you'd be the sporting type. Here is what you must do. Near to where Watcher Rylie keeps his post at the standing stones in Moon Lake, is a mad changling called LUSMOREBANE (/loc 58K, 60K). As I said before, he thinks himself a paladin. He has slaughtered many harmless creatures within Bri Leith, and he needs to be dealt with. You may need to kill his fellow 'paladins' to coax him out of his 'stable'. When you are done, bring me his head that I may know the deed is done. From Caille, head SE over a few hills then cross Moon Lake until you reach tall standing stones surrounded by Empyrean Watchers and Watcher Rylie at night and trackers by day. Just behind then, at the foot of the hills are the mad changlings. Start killing them, and soon Lusmorebane will pop. He conned yellow to my Level 34 <Player>. After dispatching him, I had his head in my backpack, and returned to Tressa. I gave her the head, and received the Elven Gossimer after hearing this...

Odharnait.horrible thing: Have you ever seen the harvest rituals that are performed in some areas around here? Most of them are simple, thanking the earth and the goddess for this year's bounty and ensuring there will be a plentiful harvest next year. But in some places like Shannon Estuary, where I just came from, they have turned to the ancient ways. They have brought back [the wickerman] sacrifice!
Odharnait.the wickerman: Oh, it is awful! They take people and put them into a large wicker cage shaped like a man. When everyone is inside, they light it on fire! Oh, those poor souls, trapped in there, sacrificed to next year's harvest. I recently witnessed one of these rituals and I fled here, since it brought back such [sad memories].
Odharnait.sad memories: About 10 years ago, my beloved Osier and I were visiting Shannon Estuary around the time of the harvest. The celebrations got out of hand, and the wickerman was raised. Osier was swept up in the masses and thrown into the wickerman. I watched in horror as he was burned with the others, a sacrifice to the mother earth and the harvest. I fled here to Silvermine Mountains and have stayed here. I haven't [left here] until recently.
Odharnait.left here: I traveled down to Shannon Estuary to visit Osier's relatives. While i was there, I went for a short walk one night. I couldn't believe my eyes - a spectral presence wandered past me and stopped. It was shaped like a wickerman, and burning, but when it looked at me, its eyes were human. I realized then who it was - my beloved Osier. He lunged at me and I fled in horror, even though I could feel he [needed something] from me.
Odharnait.needed something: I think he recognized me too. I think he wanted me to free him from that ghastly existance he has been forced into. But, I am too full of sorrow and fear to do anything. I need [someone fearless] to help me.
Odharnait.someone fearless: I think you are brave indeed, <Player>, to agree to help me with this. My whole way back up here I thought about how Osier could be freed and I think I [have a plan].
Odharnait.have a plan: I think if you were able to douse the flames that consume Osier, it would free him from this world. But ordinary water will not quench those spectral flames and no ordinary container can carry that water. You must make [an enchanted one].
Odharnait.an enchanted one: After some research, I have found that the bladder of a large red wolfhound, when enchanted, will hold the magical water you require. Seek out these [creatures] in Lough Gur or Lough Derg. When you have a bladder, take it to Uistean in Connla for more help.

Fylara MacKieran.intriduced me: Conor was impressed with my skills and immediately put me to work making armor for his army. When Conor led his forces here to Hy Brasil to aid the Sylvan, I made sure I was one of the first here. I have always made my armor from natural things, and I knew I would [find new things] here to use in my armor.
Fylara MacKieran.find new things: The bars of the trees, the hides of animals, and various parts of the wild creatures that roam the land - all these things became potential parts of armor. I studied things and tried out different combinations until I was happy. I took my creations to my father and asked him to pass them on to Conor for his opinion. Conor was most pleased and charged me with [making enough] for the entire army!
Fylara MacKieran.making enough: That wouldn't be such a problem except that Conor's army us huge! I have been trying my best to collect the items I need to make this armor, but I've been having trouble. They are fairly rare items and it takes a long time to make even one piece of armor. I could use someone to gather the items while I finish up the pieces I'm working on. Do you [know of anyone] that could help me?
Fylara MacKieran.One of the pieces: The first thing you need to get is the tongue of a gorge shriller. Their tongues are tough and hold well in battle. I have begun using them to reinforce the hinges of scale armor. You will find these creatures if you cross the wooden bridge near here and head north. I will not lie to you; getting the tongue will be the easy part. Have you heard of [the ixthiar]?
Fylara MacKieran.the ixthiar: They are vile creatures, bent on destroying anything that gets in their path. They hate all Sylvan and their allies but I've found that [a certain kind] of ixthiar has a carapace that makes very good reinforcements for armor.
Fylara MacKieran.a certain kind: I speak of the ixthiar broodmothers. They are elusive creatures, but I have discovered the secret to draw them out of their homes. Across the river and northwest of here there are five huge trees that were once in habited by Sylvan. But with the coming of the Fomorian, the Sylvan fled their homes, abandoning them to any and all creatures. The ixthiar broodmothers took up residence in these trees, producing their young to fill the land with evil. Most of the time the broodmothers live deep within the roots of the trees, but when their young are exterminated, they wil come to the surface to begin producing more. That is how you [will lure] a ixthiar broodmother out.
Fylara MacKieran.will lure: Heed my words, <Player>! I would not try this alone! Ixthiar doomcallers and reapers guard the nests. Pick one nest and exterminate all the creatures close to it. When all are dead, the broodmother will sense this and will come to the surface. You must defeat her to obtain the carapace. It will not be easy, but with a few associates you should be able to win. Once you have the pelt and the carapace, come back to me and speak with me.

Carylina.tell you: I have one that will make you more skilled in [celtic duel], one that will make you more [musical], and one that makes you better at [parrying] as well as using your shield. There is also one that makes you quite skilled with [large weapons], one that improves your skills with [scythes], and one that is good for those that use [blades]. I have a belt this is good for those that cast [regrowth] spells, and another for those that use the [Way of the Sun]. There is also one for those that walk the [Verdant Path].
Carylina.Verdant Path: I hope that as you wear this belt you will remember [Rhoiwyn's] terrible fate and it will inspire you to remove the evil Balor from this land! May the strength of the trees always keep you safe.

Orlaith.quest: It's a simple one, really. I need some magical sand from a creature called a [sanidon].
Orlaith.sanidon: They camoflague themselves in the sand around here, but I know their sand can help me make the most beautiful glass vases of all time! Do you think you could [get me some] sand?
Orlaith.get me some: Oh thank you, thank you! Like I said, the sanidon roam the sandy beaches of this area. Be careful, though. They are fierce [hunters] as well. Good luck!

Letselina.you: Yes! You see, we've been having a little bit of trouble with the bugbear nuisances lately, and we're trying to find someone to help us with the problem. Maybe you would [care to help] us?
Letselina.care to help: Excellent! Ok, we're trying to thin the bugbear herds that migrate around here, and we're having very poor luck in doing that. If you were to thin the herds for us, and bring us back their snouts as proof, I'm sure we'd [reward] you.
Letselina.reward: I'm sure we can dig up something for you. So, hurry off! There are bugbear [nuisances] to deal with!

Sarah.brave adventurer: Please pardon my sarcasm, but I have seen more than a healthy handful of brave adventurers come around here, only to be killed by the [undead].
Sarah.undead: I don't know who's doing it, but I've seen dead men and women brought back here with gouges so large in their chests, you'd think a small tree has been shoved through them! I think I know [what creature] is doing this though.
Sarah.what creature: I think it's the skeletal elk. They have antlers large enough to gouge a man nearly in half! If you find one, bring its antlers to me so I may study them and compare them to the bodies that have just arrived.

Broc.have a moment: Do you know of the melancholic fairies? Quite a nasty beast they are. Would they not travel in groups I may be a wealthy man by now. My supply of quartz has been limited by their insistence to kill any who approach their hold. I seek the help of any who might be willing to [slay a few] of these insects.
Broc.slay a few: Very well then! Return to me any [melancholic] fairy wings you may find. I will consider this proof of your deeds. Safe travels Enchanter.

Jack.Spiteful Sylvanshades: Oh aye friend. Sylvanshades are the evil counterparts to our beloved Sylvan friends. They are twisted and warped. They enjoy bringing [harm] to others.
Jack.harm: Oh yes. You'd best be careful out there. The local officials have offered a bounty to all who bring back the head of a Spiteful Sylvanshade. If you do battle with one and retrieve the head, [bring it back] to me, ok?
Jack.bring it back: Yes. I'll be sure to give you the reward for such a feat. Good luck, and don't get caught [unaware]!

Val.some time: Just bring me a few of those ant parts; these little ant workers have been everywhere lately. You could rid us of a few, couldn't you now.

Lalida.Fort Atla: Oh. Val must have sent you. I had requested his aid, but it is no longer necessary...but since you've come this way, speak with Ruk. She owes me one, tell her Lalida says hello.
Lalida.ill: They have been [staying] in one of the homes here in town to keep the poor girl warm. Please help them, they are in great need.
Lalida.Kari: Go to Kari and see if she has [completed] the remedy to cure the girl.

Dalea Gronholm.Elizabeth so wants: Elizabeth has grown a little impatient with me, although she knows I've been sick and I'm still recovering. The situation over on the mainland grows worse, and she is desperate to learn some new enchantments to aid in the fight againsta Hibernia and Albion. Her one enchantment needs the essences of different undead spirits. she's asked a few others to help her over around Mularn, but [I am to gather] the essences here.
Dalea Gronholm.I am to gather: Since I am not well enough to handle this, it falls upon you. You must take this vessel with you and obtain the essences of three psylings. Elizabeth believes there is [something] in their essence that will help our brave forces defeat the armies of Albion and Hibernia. Go now and defeat three Pyslings. As you defeat each one its essence will fill the vessel. Do not lose the vessel for then all our hard work will be for naught! If it should become lost, return to me and we will work out a solution.
Dalea Gronholm.without a special charm: When I went to Meregrota, she and I spoke of th [ -- Missing quest text -- Dalea tells you to go kill a Morvalt Ungdom and collect a finger bone, then take it to Meregrota Solvor who can place an enchantment on it that will help defeat Pyserlian.]]
Dalea Gronholm.-- Missing quest text -- Dalea tells yo: <Player>, I am glad to see you have returned. Time grows short. Do you have the vessel of essences?
Dalea Gronholm.unable to gather: Apparently there have been some problems over on the mainland, for Elizabeth recently sent me a very urgent message begging for the new components. Since I cannot get them, I am asking you to get them for me. Elizabeth needs the essences of some of the creatures that roam the lands. But before you can gather those essences, I must make the vessel to hold them. You must [get me the parts] I need to make the vessel.
Dalea Gronholm.get me the parts: There are two parts to the vessel. The first is a gilded fang from a scimitar kit. When it is cleaned out and enchanted properly, it will hold the essences Elizabeth needs. To enchant the fang I need some shimmery feathers from a boobrie hatchling. Once you have both things come back to me. May the House of Modi watch over you as you undertake this journey, <Player>." (scimitar kit can be found at loc=28k, 57k)

Anrid.did not return: In tribute of the great warrior, as baby born each generation within Vasudheim bears Gunnar's honored named. Gunnar carried with him, the fourth piece of the Grenlock crest. If you are to find this piece, you must start your journey within Musoelheim! When you have obtained it, return to me.
Anrid.a tale: Many hundreds of years ago there was a great clan of Norsemen in the northland of Midgard. They were known as the Grenlock clan, and of them was a great chieftain who strove for peace and kinship among the people. the great man, chieftain Svan Alfevsin lived and worked among his people and was greatly respected. It seems that [history] is never kind to the good hearted, like Svan Alfevson.
Anrid.history: A great tragedy befell the northlands and their king. An unnatural winter befell the land of the north, known as Urfenlong, freezing the land and water tributaries solid. Being that the Grenlock clan had always lived in a harsh climate they prepared each year with grains and livestock for a harsh winter. However, nothing could have prepared them for the [Urfenlong].
Anrid.Urfenlong: In the third year of the Urfenlong, the land and the seasons were locked in a frozen icy grip. Svan Alfevson called upon his four sons and told them to begin gathering the northland armies and supplies still left. The old king wished for his sons to move the armies and peoples of the Grenlock southward to safety, away from the impending doom of the ice. Great ice sheets moved like living things in the far north, devouring everything in their path and the farthest points of civilization had already succumbed to [the ice].
Anrid.the ice: As the ice moved closer and closer to Svergren Keep, the old king met with his sons one last time. Svan removed his own armor and divided it among his sons keeping only his helmet. Next the king took the Grenlock Crest, the family seal from upon the Keep's wall and with the blade of his battleaxe broke the seal into five pieces. Once again Svan divided the pieces of the crest, just as he did his own armor, and gave a piece to each of his four sons and [kept a piece] for himself.
Anrid.kept a piece: Svan's intention was that one-day, after the terrible unyielding winter that he and his sons would once again reunite and bring the Grenlock clan back together. Several says after Svan's sons left the northland, Svergird's Keep and its ancient stone walls were swept away by the white tide of ice and snow. The terrible storm took the old king with it, and all which remained of the northland. Svan's four sons, <Player>, <Player>, <Player>, and Div marched southward, tearing through [unknown territory].
Anrid.unknown territory: They passed through Odin's Gate and into the untamed lands continuing to push southward, where they hoped the storm could not reach. The brothers hoped that the mountains of Odin's Gate would hold back the sheets of traveling ice, yet they knew it was not safe to stay that far north. The people of the northland continued to push forward for two years, never settling, always living in fear of what could come over the mountains and sweep them away. A year later due to starvation and exhaustion, the brothers stopped the clan and settled near the sea, [nestled safely] in the mountains near what is now Vasudheim.
Anrid.nestled safely: They hoped that the mountains would stop any invading force, including the elements. It just so happens that the brothers settled in the area that is known today as Jordheim. After several more years the clan had settled in their new home. The brothers once again gathered armies from the north. The intention was for the four of them to split up in the four directions, north, east, south, and west, and explore the new territory they would call home. [Siv was the first] of the brothers to push out of their new home and travel westward.
Anrid.Siv was the first: Siv, the youngest of the brothers, put together a small following of an army and led them westward to that shore. Siv and his men settled in the area that is now known as East Svealand. It was here that his followers settled a small township and continued to explore the area in which they perceived to call home. Siv continued to live in East Svealand to the [end of his days] in peace.
Anrid.end of his days: It is rumored that his [spirit still walks] the lands which he inhabited.
Anrid.spirit still walks: You would be wise to seek Siv out and prove this rumor true!
Anrid.ready to continue: As you know Siv had three more brothers. The second brother <Player> decided since Siv was making new settlements outside of their new home that he would patrol the land. <Player>'s goal was to protect all those who survived the journey from the northland. <Player> made friends with many of the creatures that lived in the surrounding areas. It was his goal to make pacts with these creatures so that the land would stay [safe] for all those that lived there, both human and creature.
Anrid.safe: <Player> was very successful in this attempt and many aggressions were worked through. Therefore many lived in peace during his lifetime. He lived a very long time, just as his brother Siv. His spirit resides on this plane in the forests of Myrkwood among his companions, the creatures of those forests. He may have information that will help you upon this journey. He can be found among the creatures of [Myrkwood].
Anrid.Myrkwood: Seek out <Player>'s Spirit! Return to me when you have finished.
Anrid.fulfill the wish: The crest pieces can only be merged in the fires of a [forge within Muspelheim]. It is our hopes that should be this accomplished, Svan Alfevson will hear our calling and deliver unto us the final piece.
Anrid.forge within Muspelheim: Take these four pieces and seek out the dverge fire-eaters within Muspelheim. They may distrust you at first, but I am told they hate the fire giants that also walk within the fire realm. If you are able to make into the forge of five anvils, deliver all four piece to one named Sinyr. He will do his best to fashion the Grenlock [crest pieces] into one.
Anrid.crest pieces: If the last of the five piece are delivered unto you, Sinyr will make the crest while once more. I look forward to your return! You champion our cause, and we are honored you have taken on this task. Fare thee well!
Anrid.a problem: I know you have helped before, both with obtaining the crest and the sword. Now the very people of the Grenlock Clan call upon you to help solve the mystery of what is befalling them. Someone or something is trying to remove them from this world, and I can only beg that you will help them in these troubled times. Can I send word that you [are here for them]?
Anrid.see her: Her name is Danica, and she lives in Mularn. Go to her now, and tell her that Anrid sent you. I wish you luck in your endeavor.

Inaksha.the visions: In the first vision, I saw a young Norseman and woman, in a far away land. I know not what this means, although I do not think they live anymore. Another vision followed that one - a vision of a second young Norsewoman, surrounded by red, crowned in gold. I see her in a town, in the shadow of a city, and the sound of water fills my ears. Seek out this [Norsewoman], and ask her of Gashir and the elves. Return to me when you have talked with her.
Inaksha.weave a bag: Travel into the fires of Muspelheim and bring me the fur of a firecat and a noxious hound. The warmth of their fur will protect you from the cold of the Rod. Return to me when you have both and I shall weave them into a bag for you.
Inaksha.learn: I know of a young shaman. Corath, I believe is his name. He knows much of the thul. Perhaps he could enlighten us on what we should expect. He was last seen [adventuring] within the western part of Svealand. Seek him out and inquire about the rod and the Thul.
Inaksha.found: I knew you were the proper choice for this task. The Thul and the Rod of Mimir you say? Perhaps this is what I have seen in my visions! It is said in myth that the Thul were the great seekers of wisdom and the purest of heart and spirit. I must [meditate] on this and decide on where next to direct your focus. I thank you for your service!

Jana.knowledge: My visions did not reveal what you want to know, only that you would come seeking me. Tell me what you wish to learn about.
Jana.childhood: My grandparents died when I was very young, but before they died, they told me of their raiding days. They were in a raiding party that ventured into Hibernia. One night after they had made a camp for the night, they told stories of the magic of the gods. My grandmother told the tale of the Rod of Mimir. A group of elves, which had gained the ability to understand our language, overheard the story as they prepared to [ambush the camp].
Jana.ambush the camp: During the ambush, they killed everyone except my grandparents. They took my grandmother captive as my grandfather escapted into the woods. The elves forced my grandmother to tell them all she knew of the Rod of Mimir. It was many days later that she managed to escape, and she and my grandfather fled back to the safety of Midgard. The [elves pursued] because they did not want anyone to know they sought the Rod.
Jana.elves pursued: Once here, they began their search, and captured passing travlers until they learned fro the proper ritual to summon Mimir. With the Rod, they can summon Mimir and force him to do their bidding. Unfortunately, their tongues are not well adapted to our language, and Mimir comes out as Gashir. After reading many ancient texts, I have discovered that there is another creature named Gashir, an evil demon who delights in destruction and chaos. If Gashir is released in this world, we will be doomed! That is all I can tell you of Gashir and the elves. I beg you, if you have the ability to stop the elves, please do so.

Mielikka.someone else: I have received word from one of the merchants around here that she is looking for a courageous berserker to help her with something. Her name is Dalea and she is [collecting] things. She didn't say exactly what would be collected only that it might be difficult but the reward would be worth the work. S, [what do you say? Cound you help Dalea out?

Thordia.worthy of the task: Seek Viking Karl at the tower in the hills. He will explain what needs to be done.

Viking Karl.on the hunt: ?There is one vile beast that has feasted on many of my men. Thordia has promised me a great warrior. Kill Hrrgyf, the hill cat that roams the mountains here. Bring me her tooth, as proof of your deed.
Viking Karl.with hunting: The vile beast Hrrgyf has feasted on many of my men. Jaakko claims that this hill cat will not feast upon a Savage. Kill Hrrgyf and bring me her tooth, as proof of your deed. She roams the mountains near here.

Karle Alfevson.Crest: Aye. I think that using the talisman and the primitive icons of this land would be appropriate. So, what do you [think]?
Karle Alfevson.think: Morvalt ungdom often carry primitive tokens of luck. Find two morvalt ungdom and bring me their tokens!
Karle Alfevson.exploring: Have you seen the giant sea beast that has been [ravaging the town] when it can't feed off anything else?
Karle Alfevson.ravaging the town: Well, not the whole town. Just the people in it. The beast belongs out to sea, but somehow, it got stuck here, in the inlet of water and the harbor. [Occasionally], when it runs out of fresh fish and can't find any animals roaming the shores, it comes to town. We need to kill this beast.

Sarry.attacking travelers: Aye! I haven't had time to talk to her; the guards took her away. Perhaps you could [speak with Sentry Litenberg], at Dvalin, and see what needs to be done to free her. I'm not sure she's there yet; the escorts came for her.
Sarry.ill: They have been [staying] in one of the homes here in town to keep the poor girl warm. Please help them, they are in great need.
Sarry.Kari: Go to Kari and see if she has [completed] the remedy to cure the girl.

Sentry Litenberg.wish her to live: Fine. You prove she not kill travelers at night, she go free. Have 'til morning, or she die here in tower. Speak with her, if you haven't already. If she not here, she on road to here.
Sentry Litenberg.a branch: Well then, I know where you need to search. Go to the western shore of the big lake in West Svealand. The lone willow you seek can be found there, just south of Vindsaul Faste. You must take the branch to Eirik of Audliten. Only he can work that wood.

Danica.solve the mystery: Since Anrid came to me, I have been going through all the stories I know related to the Clan but I've reference to visitors from a far off land that resulted in the death of a girl of the clan named Freyana. Freyana was the most beloved daughter of the clan at the time these visitors came to Midgard. It was said she was so beautiful when she was born that she was named after the goddess of beauty, <Player>. But [something happened] to her while she was still young.
Danica.something happened: Unfortunately I do not know what caused it, but somehow Freyana died saving her childhood friend; a troll named Ljagnid. Healers of the Clan worked desperately to save Freyana's life, but their magics failed and her spirit was held here instead of travelling on to Valhalla. Legends say that Freyana's spirit grew bitter and ugly with her resentment towards the clan but especially to Ljagnid. She haunted him, sending horrible things [to torment him] day and night.
Danica.to torment him: The torment became too much for him and he died from a mixture of fear and grief. Freyana watched this with joy, for she felt she was avenged. But her joy quickly turned to anger when she saw that Ljagnid was being taken to Valhalla, a place she had long been denied. She shrieked a curse at Ljagnid, and bound him to her, keeping him trapped here in the same tortured existance she suffers. It is rumored that Freyana and [Ljagnid] now roam around Vanern Swamp together, for that is where both their bodies where laid to rest, with the great kings and queens of Midgard.
Danica.Ljagnid: In the stories I have found, it was speculated that Ljagnid wrote down his story and what brought about Freyana's death. If we only had that book! Some say it was lost forever while others say Ljagnid took the book with him when he died. Only you can [discover the truth] now, child.
Danica.discover the truth: You must travel to the sweltering depths of Vanern Swamp and seek out Freyana and Ljagnid at night and see if Ljagnid has this book. Freyana is evil, and cannot stand having Ljagnid around but she cannot let him go, they say. So she forces him into hiding most of the time, but when something tries to harm her, and try things do, for she is a most evil creature now, Ljagnid springs from hiding to help her. I fear you will not be able to face Freyana and Ljagnid alone, for they have both grown very strong. Gather your forces and take them with you for protection. Remember, Freyana only roams at night. If you are able to obtain the book, bring it back to me here.
Danica.continues: The visitors have begun to learn the language of the clan, and we theirs. Freyana continues to hide me and the other trolls from Kelic, the leader of the magic users. She is too protective of me. I told her I wish to learn their language too, and she promised me she would teach me. I think tomorrow I will sneak close to their encampment and see them for myself. I am curious to see if they look like the Clan or like me. Freyana has come back to my hidings place to bring me food. I must go eat now and finish this later. Ljagnid stops writing there and did not finish on that day. [His next entry] is about Freyana's death. Perhaps this will help us.
Danica.His next entry: 'Ingvarr and his friends have been searching for a week now, but have not found the visitors. Everyone thought they had made it to their own lands until <Player> showed up. He said that the deserters of the Clan had taken in the visitors and were making a deal with them. <Player> feared the deal and left them, returning to the Clan. He begged to be accepted back into the Clan, but no one trusts him. The Alfevsons took him back in, but they secretly set someone to watch him at all times. I think <Player> is [up to no good].'
Danica.up to no good: A few days later Ljagnid writes, 'I was right. <Player> left us again today, but he said he wasn't returning to the deserters. He still feared the visitors. He told us he was going north, because he thought the visitors were going to do something bad to the Clan and to the deserters. Some people went with him, but we never saw any of them again. When he left, I saw him carrying a bunch of scrolls. I checked with everyone, but no one was missing any, so they must have belonged to <Player> after all. Something strange is happening to me. I have started seeing strange creatures no one else sees. I am scared.' That is where the book ends. [Interesting], is it not?
Danica.Interesting: Now, before you start wondering, I know of these rengades Ljagnid wrote of in his journal. They were once Clansmen and women. When the Clan moved into the area, they had two choices - live in peace with the trolls, kobolds, and dwarves, or conquer them. The Alfvesons, chose to live in peace, and this made some of the Clan members [angry].
Danica.angry: These members did not like the non-human races. They felt that co-existing with them rather than ruling them showed weakness. Rather than live in that situation, they packed up and left, following the loudest of them, <Player>. I guess you could say they are the forerunners to the Blodfelags that roam the lands now. He led them out into the wilderness, where they roamed for a short time until they mysteriously died out. They had no name for themselves, but in the Clan they were referred to as the deserters. I also know of this man, [<Player>].
Danica.<Player>: I have a few notes about him in different books. He and his followers moved around quite a bit, but finally settled in Raumarik. It is said his spirit still haunts the land, although now he fears everyone, thinking they have been sent by either the deserters or the visitors. I believe the scrolls he took will contain the answer to what the visitors planned to do to the Clan. I need you to travel now to Raumarik and find <Player>. His followers are always with him, hoping for his protection, so take many with you to defeat them. When you reach Raumarik, head to the river. Cross the river and head north until you find <Player>. Return to me when you have the scrolls of <Player>.

Morlin Caan.the Albion undead: I fear that killing Pellinistra didn't end the reign of the undead here in our beloved land. I think someone has either taken her place or more likely [someone] was controlling Pellinistra and now has chosen someone else to lead the undead against us.
Morlin Caan.someone: We will not be rid of the undead until we are sure we have found and dealt with the one from Albion that leads this fight. Will you aid Masrim and myself again in [purging our land] of this evil that plagues it?
Morlin Caan.purging our land: I knew we could count on one from the House of Loki. In the note Masrim sent to me, she spoke of messages she had received from across the land. The most pressing message came from Gunnolf in Vindsaul Faste on the edge of West Svealand, although he did not include many details. Travel to him now and find out what you can of these new undead [invaders] on our land.
Morlin Caan.axe: An axe, eh? Would you prefer [one handed] or [two handed]?
Morlin Caan.two handed: Here is your axe, my friend. May the House of Loki keep watch over you until Masrim and I need you again, and we most certainly will need you if this pact between the realms is true!

Gunnolf.what I've seen: I was out on patrol recently in Yggdra Forest. As I was returning, I happened to catch a glimpse of a person dressed in black meeting with another in the same attire. I didn't think too much of it, for both seemed harmless enough. I saw something pass from one hand to another - something round and white, kind of like a bone or a skull. They both [headed off] in opposite directions after the item changed hands.
Gunnolf.headed off: It was a few days after that the reports started coming in from travelers about a group of undead roaming the Forest. They have been seen in [many places].
Gunnolf.many places: They seem to avoid the guards and patrols, but the travelers speak of them near the water at night. Since they avoid the patrols, I believe you will be able to find them, If you see them, do not hesitate to attack. Masrim has said she cannot solve the riddle of who controls the undead without knowing how they are controlled.

Masrim.a few creatures: The sidhe draoi still use scrying crystals. Head to Skona Ravine. When you reach the circle of stones, head west down a deep ravine, When you come out of the ravine, head south to the water. The sidhe draoi live alond the water. When you have a scrying crystal, return to me." (or he will send you to the Isalf Scryers in Yggdra or Uppland Go to Skona Ravine and kill a Sidhe Draoi Step #5
Masrim.find her: Tell me, were you able to learn the name of the creature we seek? Tell it to me know.

Rana.amazing story: There was once a time, long ago when this world was ruled by the hands of the gods. Oh yes, the Aesir and Jotun were very prevalent in this day in age. It was a time of myth and legend, young one. For I can see it in my visions. My visions extend long into the past, during [ancient] times, and I see into the murky future. For it is our past and our future that make us who we are.
Rana.ancient: I see a man, wearing priestly garb, he is holding a great staff and waving it. For which direction the staff points is uncertain. If waved at the field, that field grow. If waved at an opposition there is ending. However the direction the staff points now is uncertain. It is lost to me, even though there may be great suffering or great joy this staff must be found. I do not know what it mean, [my visions] of this time are so fuzzy.
Rana.my visions: Perhaps the scholar Gorne can make sense of these visions. Please, [find him]. He may be the only person who can unravel this mystery for me.
Rana.a hundred men: Oh fear not, we shall not send you against a hundred men! You only need to face two. There are creatures called naive sjora. They can be fierce when engaged in combat. I want you to face two naive sjora. I will need proof that you defeated them and didn't run from combat. Naive sjora wear shell necklaces. I want you to get one of those. Also. when naive sjora die, they will often utter some words. You must listen to them and remember that word. Once you have both, return to me here. I wish you luck!

For it is our past and our future that make us who we are.
Grimma.ancient: I see a man, wearing priestly garb, he is holding a great staff and waving it. For which direction the staff points is uncertain. If waved at the field, that field grow. If waved at an opposition there is ending. However the direction the staff points now is uncertain. It is lost to me, even though there may be great suffering or great joy this staff must be found. I do not know what it mean, [my visions] of this time are so fuzzy.
Grimma.my visions: Perhaps the scholar Gorne can make sense of these visions. Please, [find him]. He may be the only person who can unravel this mystery for me.

Elizabeth.she desires: She desires the heart of a battle-scarred mauler. It is the final component Tyria needs for a charm she wished to make. Travel to Skona Ravine and get the heart. Take it to Tyria in Vindsaul Faste. She will then give you what I seek, along with the location of the second half.
Elizabeth.three basic things: It's almost humorous, to think that three simple things, when combined in the right amounts, will create such a powerful enchantment. The gods do have a sense of humor after all, it appears. When you hear what the three things are, you would never think to put them together. Well, let me send you out for [one thing] first. According to the book, it will take the longest to prepare. Then I shall have you get the other two.
Elizabeth.one thing: You must travel into Varulvhamn in Skona Ravine. Seek out a werewolf noble and acquire its pelt. Once you have it, return to me.
Elizabeth.other items: You must travel to Uppland. There hunt for the wyvern and the taiga cat. From the wyvern, get a scale. The scale contains many magical properties of the gods and is essential to the enchantment. From the taiga cat, bring me a claw. The claw will add sharpness to the weapons I enchant. Return to me when you have both.
Elizabeth.shield: An axe, eh? Give me but a minute and I shall have it.

Tyria.the item: It is but a trifle really, a small token from [a creature] of the ice and snow.
Tyria.a creature: There are creatures in Yggdra's Forest known simply as blocks of ice. You must seek out one and retrieve its icy heart. Once you have it, return to me and I shall give you the tome.

Jaakko.on the hunt: Kelgor wishes you to go hunt for hill cats! Prove your skill in battle. Get me five teeth from the hill cats to prove you are a member of the house of [Kelgor]!
Jaakko.wants more proof: The Viking Karl cannot deal with a problem he is having. Go speak to him and show him that Savages are strong!

Siv Alfevson.granted: I traveled many years, running in fear from the terrible consuming northern storm. After may years my brothers and I settled our armies and clan and built shelter and a new civilization after the terrible storm that wiped away our homeland. Our father stayed behind, leaving us with only pieces of his armor and pieces of our great clan crest of Grenlock. I too stay behind to watch over what is left of [our clan] here in these parts.
Siv Alfevson.our clan: There is little of the Grenlock Clan left, only our people and the shards of the crest my father entrusted me to us, both now scattered to the wind. You must make sure to gather the crest piece from my long dead wife, [Ulga}. This must be done at all costs!

Ulga.Siv: It is doubtful that he has sent you! If you wish the crest, you must take it by force!

Kalli.ill: They have been [staying] in one of the homes here in town to keep the poor girl warm. Please help them, they are in great need.
Kalli.Kari: Go to Kari and see if she has [completed] the remedy to cure the girl.

Budo.Skadi: Skadi is the giantess of the hunt. She was greatly beloved by both Aesir and Jotun. She is of the [Great House of the Jotun].
Budo.Great House of the Jotun: The Great House of Jotun is made up of the gods living in Jotunheim, home of the Giants. Once you have grown stronger, and a bit wiser, return to your trainer. You must then choose which of the gods to follow.

Boidoc.Loki: You can join the House of Loki. He is the giant of fire and the great trickster. If you choose to follow Loki you will become a shadowblade. You will follow his example and become a member of the [Great House of Jotun].
Boidoc.Great House of Jotun: The Great House of Jotun is made up of the gods living in Jotunheim, home of the Giants. If ever you wre to go to Jotunheim, you would find [Skadi] dwelling there.
Boidoc.Skadi: To learn more about Skadi seek out Budo here in Fort Atla.

Amora.Magnild: Yes, my poor darling Magnild was bitten by a [water snake] while traveling into town. Unfortunately, the bite has not healed and she is not feeling very well at all.
Amora.water snake: Oh, it seems the venom of the snake was very powerful. I have sent word to t he healer and she has told me she needs five vials of [snake venom] to cure the child.
Amora.snake venom: I do not feel right leaving Magnild [here alone] this ill, so I fear I can't hunt the snakes myself.
Amora.here alone: Please go outside the city and [collect] the five vials of venom and take them to Kari, the healer.
Amora.collect: I am indebted to you always if you do the for me.

Kari.work: You have aided in this situation beyond what is expected. I thnk you.
Kari.right time: I have been working with the snake venom now for several days, it was not easy to [brew] down.
Kari.brew: However, I think I have finished the [remedy] for Magnild's bite.
Kari.remedy: Take it and deliver it to the girl quickly. The longer we wait the worse her condition becomes I'm afraid.

Pedra.eaten: Aye, and now Kedra, the healer, is busy sorting out the worst! It turns out we are ate some bad fish. Now, Kedra says she is running our of her cure, and doesn't have time to get any more of the [ingredients]! Do you think you could help?
Pedra.interested: Aye. Bernt's his name, He's a bit of an explorer. He's got wind of some mineral [deposits] he would like to take a look at. He's always got a job for those looking to explore a bit.
Pedra.Nibalk: Yes. He's a troll. He's also a bit of a spiritual leader in this area. He's working on the Valkyn [problem].
Pedra.problem: It seems the Mother, that old, vile diety that are [worshipped] by the more primitive of the Valkyn have begun to haunt them. The ones that have been here a while have been suffering terribly from lack of sleep. Perhaps you could help?

Kedra.sick: Yes. Sick. Why are you here? Are you sick? You don't look sick to me. You can help me. I am running out of my cure! I don't have time to go get the [marine fungus] I need!
Kedra.marine fungus: Aye. I mash it up and add herbs to it. It's a great cure! I need more though! Go get me a marine fungus. I will pay you for it! And the whole town will thank you, when they are through wretching up the illness, that is.

Aegan.worthy of the hunt: Oh ho! Another bright young come to help Midgard fend off her enemies, eh? Wonderful, that's what I say! Wonderful! With the rise of the [Albion] and [Hibernia] armies,Midgard will need all the she can get!
Aegan.Hibernia: I have spent a great deal of my life hunting the [maulers] of this region
Aegan.maulers: Bring me the claws of a mauler cub and I shall [reward] you
Aegan.information and assistance: I have done what I can from here, would you care to further [help my friend]?
Aegan.help my friend: Take this with you and seek out Kell in Fort [Veldon]. You must hurry!

Dwarven Guard Rinda.lost keys: Oh yes. It is dreadful that I was so careless as to lost them like this! You see, I am responsible for helping to lock the money the merchants bring in during the day into a large chest. I am the only one with the keys, and I have [misplaced them].
Dwarven Guard Rinda.misplaced them: Oh, this makes me so angry! I have searched all around Haggerfel for them, but they are no where to be found. I don't suppose you would have a [little time] to help me out, would you?

Gridash.bone hilt swords: Aye! They are some of my finest works! I don't suppose you [would care for one] eh?

Krek.Wariel: She is quite well known throughout the area and it would benefit you to [learn] the secrets of trapping.

Wariel.realm: Did you know that the [art] of trapping is very important here in Midgard, for everyone?
Wariel.art: Yes, [trapping] is an art, the skinning of an animal, preserving the pelt and tanning it for use.
Wariel.trapping: Trapping and doing these things correctly can [fetch] you a good deal of popularity to traders and bring in a nice profit.
Wariel.fetch: Go in to woods and see if yo ucan capture fice tawny lynx cubs and bring their pelts to me so that I may prepare them.
Wariel.job: I shall begin preserving and tanning these skins shortly. Once they are finished tanning I may have another job for you.

Torold Sterkkriger.Morvaltar: As you may know, the Morvaltar are your wild cousins. We of Midgard do not fear Valkyn like you, for as a group you have more than proven your loyalty to King Goran. Many Valkyn have also proven that they are strong, intelligent, and brave. These are [the qualities] that all Vikings must possess before they can choose where their destiny lies.
Torold Sterkkriger.the qualities: Now, young one, prepare yourself. You have three trials to face before I can allow you to make your destiny. These trials are designed to separate the true Vikings from the everyday Valkyn. So, prepare yourself now, for you trial is waiting for you. It is a test to [prove your strength]. Only the strongest will survive in this land.
Torold Sterkkriger.third and final trial: The kast trial you will face will prove your bravery. If you pass this trial, you will have shown that you have the potential to survive in the wilds of Aegir. Are [you ready] to face this third trial?

Jorund Bruttstein.one of the creatures: You must seek out a marine fungus. They may be found in the waters south and southwest of here. Find one and defeat it. Once you have, obtain proof that you have accomplished this test. Return to me here.

Magnild.grateful: I have not felt myslef in so long time. Oh I hope this [asists me].
Magnild.asists me: I must say that I am feeling a tad better already. I do not know how I can thank you, but I shall never forget your aid to me.

Kran.learn: Knowledge is the key that will unlock many doors for you. Understanding and knowing your surroundings is your ally and [teamwork] your backbone.
Kran.teamwork: These are difficult times for our people and therefore you must understand that [camaraderie] between your fellows is very important.
Kran.camaraderie: Reach out to others. Form a grouping with one or more fellows and return to me once you have accomplished this.
Kran.task: Take your new found group into the countryside and look for the hobgoblin fish catchers and return to me with a token of the task set before you.

Bernt.exploring: Aye, I could use your aid, if you don't mind a bit of danger. You see, there's some minerals embedded in some rocks not too far from here. Now it's not a whole mine or anything, but I want to know what sort of mineral it is. There's one [problem].
Bernt.problem: Aye, there's some creatures about that make it hard to get to. Now, I'd go and fight off the creatures myself, but you know, I've got some work to do here, and really can't be bothered. That's why I'm [willing to pay] you.
Bernt.willing to pay: Ha! Of course I'm going to pay! I've been here long enough to know nobody's here for the pleasure of being here! Everyone wants something! Land! Treasure! Fame! Whatever it is. Well, are you [satisfied] I'll pay you?
Bernt.satisfied: There are some stray scimitar cubs near the mineral deposit. Remove the cubs to find the deposit. Many cuvs are found bsouthwest, just past the bridge.

Bolli.Mularn: Ah, I've lived here nearly my entire life, well, most of it anyhow. Since my accident, though, I've had to take up another hobby besides adventuring. Did you know I do [leatherworking]?
Bolli.leatherworking: Oh aye, I have become quite handy with a leather working tool. But alas, I seem to have [misplaced] it recently.
Bolli.misplaced: I know...I know...I should have put it and my leather pieces away before heading to bed, but I just plain forgot! I don't suppose you could help a crippled old man [look] for it, can you?
Bolli.skinning knife: It is a wonderful knife, give to me as a present from a very old and sweet friend. I would be very appreciative if you could find it for me. I know there are creatures aroudn that like [shiny objects].
Bolli.shiny objects: Hrm...Huldus come to mind. There are a bunch of them on a hill to the west, right outside of town. See if one of them has my knife.
Bolli.willing to get it: I knew you would. I was using the shinbone of a rattling skeleton to smooth out my skins so I could start making my leather. THat is now gone also. I think the skeleton I took if from [took it back].
Bolli.took it back: Honestly, I didn't know they would be so sensitive, but it was the perfect bone for the job. Please go out and get me another shinbone!
Bolli.tale: With my addition, her group was complete. We ran all over Midgard, slaying beasts, helping villagers... We had a splendid time. We had gained enough wisdom and insight that we went to Muspelheim in search of new adventure, [new opponents], and new riches.
Bolli.new opponents: Aye, and new opponents were to be found everywhere in Muspelheim. At first, we were giddy and excited. We had found a nest of lava lizards and enjoyed ridding the world of them. Little did we know they had a [keeper].
Bolli.keeper: Lava lizards are related to a family of drakes called Fire Drakes. These Fire Drakes have higher ranking members amongst them. One of these was a [Young Fire Wyrm Lord].
Bolli.Young Fire Wyrm Lord: And a dreadful site he was too. Larger than other beast I've seen, he roams around Muspelheim, like the Lord of the manor! He didn't take too [kindly] to us beatin' on his kinfolk.
Bolli.slaughtered: I don't know you too well, traveler, but if you're brave of heart and stout of spirit, then perhaps you'd like to visit the creature and slay him. I wish you luck on your journeys, friend. Be wary of the evils in Muspelheim.

Nibalk.meditate: Aye. It is not my nature to do so, but it had to be done. I finally had to beg for help from the [gods].
Nibalk.gods: Well, I certainly can't defeat a deity. Gazsi himself can't, though he is just as afflicted as the rest! He can't do the simplest tasks. The nightmares of the Mother has inflicted upon them all has made them [weak].
Nibalk.weak: Yes. Weak. But I have appealed to the gods, and as you are here, I can only think I have been answered. They have promised me their aid in defeating the Mother. But they have asked a small [price].
Nibalk.price: They fell it is weakness that has allowed the Mother to enter the minds of the followers of the Norse gods, so we must prove our strength. If we prove our strength, than they will lend us theirs. So, I've a [challenge] for you.
Nibalk.challenge: This is not about brains, but strength. I need you defeat three naive sjoras. Bring me their ears, as proof. This will prove some strength, I think, to the gods that have answered me. Remember, return with three ears!
Nibalk.<Player>: Yes, that large sea beast that's been devouring people everywhere. I understand that Ota, Karle, and Longbeard are all offering rewards for the carcass, to hang as trophies. I don't think that's what should be done! What a waste! No no no no listen to me. Take the carcass to the [Mussalkan].
Nibalk.Mussalkan: A creature like <Player> is a gift to them! Althought they know him as Molvor. They can do so much with it! They will give you tokens, talismans, and trinkets of all sorts if you give them the carcass of a beast such as <Player>! These trinkets and tokens, and the talismans, if you bring them to me, I will pay you not only for killing <Player>, bu also for the trinkets they give you in exchange for the carcass! Think of it. It's worth more to ya!

Tric.can help: I lost my [book of spells] in a battle. I am in no condition to recover it.
Tric.book of spells: It was a battle against a great goblin called Gib and his followers. The rest of my party was slain in battle. I was wounded and forced to retreat to this town. If you could [recover it] I would be grateful.
Tric.recover it: Many thanks. To find the place we battled, follow the road out of this town until you reach the main road. Turn left and [continue] for a few paces. You should notice them.

Gwaell.a moment: I have learned how to craft them from a few [tomte bracers].
Gwaell.tomte bracers: Yes, the jerkin requires a total of three tomte bracers in order to have enough material to create. You show interest in this object. Would you like me to [craft one] for you?
Gwaell.craft one: Very well then, find three of these [bracers] and return them to me.

Frimeth.is needed: A [scourge] has presented itself at a location not far from here.
Frimeth.scourge: Aye! Tis a place where many of my kind have met their deaths... [A hole] in the bottom the earth that sucks the last bit of life from all dwarves who fall dead upon its barren ground.
Frimeth.A hole: Beware [the hole's power], for should you fall dead yourself you may rise up as one of it's minions.
Frimeth.the hole's power: I could tap this power for you and [fashion an item] of great use. That is if you are brave enough to meet this terror.
Frimeth.fashion an item: Aye! If you could bring me [dust] from one of the [dwarven skeletons] which walks there, I will create it for you.
Frimeth.dwarven skeletons: This dust can only be taken while you wield the gift [bestowed] to you by your house.
Frimeth.tell me: Perhaps you should check your backpack. I think I see your house gift sticking out of the top of it.

Hilde.ran me out of town: You know, it used to be that people around here were pretty much open to anything and anyone until rumors came in about the Blodfelag.
Hilde.quite a few tasks: He helped me in crafting armor and weapons as well as planning out the design I had for a [new forge].
Hilde.new forge: The other towns people tried to run us out of town, but at the time I didn't want to [lose my job] so I told Quirk he should leave.
Hilde.lose my job: The little bugger stole my plans and took off with them. Last I saw he was heading back towards the huldu camp. Haven't seen him since. Please find him and try to get my plans back.

Carr.terrible mean: Is a frightening time! Scared of the [Hobgoblin Anklebiter]!
Carr.Hobgoblin Anklebiter: Anklebiter mean Lieutenant to Smyga. Smyga and Anklebiter [planning something awful] they are.
Carr.planning something awful: No, am scared of plans Anklebiter may carry out [in Smyga's orders].
Carr.in Smyga's orders: Yes! Can find the Anklebiter in the Hobgoblin Camp. Anklebiter always carry out orders. Bring Smyga's Orders from Anklebiter.
Carr.very upset: Smyga thinks humans stupid and [mean], attacking all hobgoblins home and camps humans are.
Carr.mean: Smyga's Orders read that Anklebiter must gather all hobgoblin forces. [Gather forces] to attack the humans.
Carr.Gather forces: Carr doesn't like Smyga. Carr likes humans better so Carr will [tell you].
Carr.tell you: Smyga plan a raid on human city of [Jordheim]. You must help.
Carr.Jordheim: Hurry! Hurry and find Smyga, so he can't take Jordheim. If he is defeated, hobgoblins have no leader and will not attack. Is only way to save city.

Yver Tiu.Ickerius: The Ickerius arachnid, also known as the Ick spider, is a small tree spider, roughly three feet in length with a yellow tinge to it's body. Truly a marvelous creature, one we're lucky to have found. It's [silk] is used to make some of our fishing nets.
Yver Tiu.silk: Some of the strongest silk comes from the Ick spider. Amazing, really, that such a small creature can produce something of such quality and strength. I was [wondering], since you are here, would you care to run an errand for me?
Yver Tiu.Garon: Ah, this silk looks very nice. Did he happen to have any notes on where he found it or anything? [Step #3]Give the scroll to Yver.
Yver Tiu.Step #3: Ah, his notes, excellent! Oh ho! What have we here? Possible magic properties within the silk? Excellent! But, that means that we have more [work] ahead of us to protect and scrye out why this silk is magical.
Yver Tiu.work: Aye friend, more work! While you were gone, I read more of Garon's letter. He said there was a small nest of baby spiders on the wooded isle near Audliten. There is something [preying] on them.
Yver Tiu.preying: Aye friend. They upset the balance of nature. You should hurry to Audliten at once. There you will find a small wooded isle. On the isle are the plague rats. Kill them and return to me when you are finished.
Yver Tiu.up for it: Excellent! Remember the ickerius spider I told you about earlier? Well, it seems there's one that roams about in Gotar! We need this specimen for study! The locals have called it [Ick], apparently, ickerius is too hard for them to pronounce.
Yver Tiu.Ick: Aye, the ickerius spider is a nasty spider. Be careful, it has a powerful bite. I can give you directions. Travel to Nalliten, from there, go south on the road. When you reach the fork, go southeast over the bridge. He is near the mountain.
Yver Tiu.sincere gratitude: Here you are friend. I had my compatriot, <Player>, look over the silk. He said it had properties that would benefit someone like you. I hope you can use it for some time to come. Again, I think you for all your hard work!
Yver Tiu.spiders: There are so many varieties in Midgard, it would take me days on end to list them all. I'm sure a seasoned adventurer like yourself has seen many of them. Perhaps, though, you'd be willing to assist an old man with a project?
Yver Tiu.parts: My friend, <Player>, who lives in Fort Atla has recently made a strange discovery with some spinnerets. He wants me to look them over. Please take this note to him and bring the spinnerets back to me so I may further examine them.
Yver Tiu.more to be done: You are truly a skilled and valuable asset to Midgard. For this, I salute you! Through your bravery and selflessness, you have demonstrated that you are more than [trustworthy] for my next task!
Yver Tiu.trustworthy: While you were out and about for me, I sent others like you on similar quests. All have returned various spider parts to me, and I am most disturbed at what I see. I believe there are those that are deliberately tampering with the [forces of magic].
Yver Tiu.forces of magic: I know of one way to cull it, but I require another favour from you. Deep within west Svealand live the Blodfelag clan. Within their ranks are shamantic priests known as the [haxa].
Yver Tiu.haxa: Because the Blodfelag are purely Norse, they have defiled the laws of nature by attempting to subvert the Shaman's magic to their own twisted ways. They have destroyed the land around them with their corruption, as well as the animals. These spider parts tell me that their magic is spreading to other parts of the land, not just remaining localised around their fortress. I must obtain a haxa charm necklace in order to perform a [rite] to banish their magic from corrupting any others.
Yver Tiu.rite: It would take far too long to explain right now, and we are quickly running out of time. Please retrieve this necklace for me so I might curb those that would harm Midgard.
Yver Tiu.Widower: He is thusly called for the men he has killed and widows he has made. While his power seems weak at the moment, I cannot help but think that it will grow strong soon. My brother has agreed to help up with this. He shall meet you in Myrkwood and together you shall find this creature and slay him. Should he regain his powers, there's no telling [what will happen].
Yver Tiu.what will happen: I fear Midgard is in peril friend. Quickly, travel to Myrkwood, he will meet you at the web covered tree near Spindelhalla. Quickly, you must hurry!
